blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present PhysInsert, a framework for physically plausible reference-based object insertion that jointly adapts objects and their surrounding scenes. Existing methods often rely on masked inputs, generation-based pairs, or training pairs with limited viewpoint variation, leaving pose and illumination adaptation and bidirectional object-scene interactions insufficiently constrained. We construct the Insert World dataset with strictly aligned Blender-rendered counterfactual pairs and object references across viewpoints and lighting conditions. Building on these data, Geometry-Guided Adaptation couples a VGGT geometry stream with image and text streams under target-scene feature supervision to guide spatially consistent insertion. Complementary 2D Object-Scene Spatial Supervision jointly supervises object occupancy and environmental changes while grounding spatial instructions in object regions through image-text attention. We introduce PhysInsert-Bench with dedicated cross-environment and cross-view cases requiring illumination and pose adaptation beyond appearance copying. Experiments on PhysInsert-Bench and DreamBooth demonstrate improved image fidelity; a user study further shows more accurate placement and improved lighting integration, perspective, and pose plausibility.
blocks.zh: 我们提出物理Insert,这是物理上可行的基于参考对象插入的框架,它共同适应物体及其周围场景。 现有方法往往依赖遮掩输入、基于生成的对等或视差有限的培训对等,使姿势和光线适应以及双向物体-场面相互作用受到的限制不够。 我们用严格对齐的Blender反事实对和对象参考来构建“插入世界”数据集。 在这些数据的基础上,几何指南适应夫妇在目标场景的监督下,用一股有图像和文字流的VGGT几何流来指导空间相容的插入。 补充的2D对象-场景空间监督联合监督物体占用和环境变化,同时通过图像-文字关注在物体区域进行空间指令的地面. 我们介绍PhysInsert-Bench, 包含专门的跨环境和交叉视图案例, 需要发光, 并做出超出外观复制的适应。 关于PhysInsert-Bench和DreamBooth的实验显示图像忠贞性得到提高;一项用户研究进一步显示更准确的放置并改进了照明的融合,视角,并提出了可信度.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Reference-based object insertion aims to integrate a specified object into a target scene while preserving its identity.
Physically plausible insertion further requires geometric and optical consistency, with the object’s perspective, pose, appearance, and effects on its surroundings all adapted to the target scene.
blocks.zh:
基于引用的对象插入旨在将指定的对象整合到目标场景中,同时保留其身份.
物理上可行的插入还需要几何和光学上的一致性,与物体的视角、姿势、外观和对周围环境的影响都适应目标场景。

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Figure 1 , despite recent progress, three challenges remain in physically plausible object insertion. (a) Adaptation across environments. Existing methods ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Song et al., 2025 ; Tian et al., 2025 ) can insert objects into new scenes, but provide limited controlled supervision for adapting the same object across lighting environments. (b) Bidirectional object–scene interactions. Mask-and-fill methods ( Gong et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) may adapt object illumination yet struggle to produce consistent scene changes; training pairs constructed through masking or generative editing ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Song et al., 2025 ) do not guarantee accurate supervision of shadows and reflections.
Training examples with simplified backgrounds ( Michel et al., 2023 ) also underrepresent complex occlusion, attachment, and spatial relationships with existing scene objects. (c) Adaptation across viewpoints. Even with consistent illumination, differing reference and target viewpoints still require perspective and pose adaptation; fixed-view training pairs ( Yang et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) offer limited supervision for this change.
Reliance on mask or box guidance also limits fine-grained text control of placement and pose ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Gong et al., 2026 ) .
Methods relying primarily on 2D image supervision ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Song et al., 2025 ) lack direct constraints on object–scene geometry, making it difficult to guide adaptation to the target perspective and pose.
blocks.zh:
如图1所示,尽管最近取得了进展,在插入实物方面仍有三项挑战。 (a) 各种环境的适应。 现有方法(Chen等人,2024a); Song et al., 2025 ; Tian et al., 2025 )可以将物体插入到新的场景中,但提供有限的控制监督,以在照明环境中调整同一物体. (b) 双向物体-场面相互作用。 面具和填充方法(Gong等人,2026年;Yu等人,2025年)可能调整物体照明,但为产生一致的场景变化而挣扎;通过面具或基因编辑构建的训练对(Chen等人,2024a年; Song et al., 2025)并不保证准确监督阴影和反射.
具有简化背景的培训实例(Michel等人,2023年)也不足以说明与现有场景物体的复杂隔离、附着和空间关系。 (c) 不同观点的适应。 即使始终如一的照明,不同的参考和目标观点仍然需要视角并形成适应;固定视角培训对等(Yang等人,2023年;Wang等人,2025年b)对这一变化提供有限的监督。
依赖面具或盒式制导也限制了精细的文字对放置和姿势的控制(Chen等人,2024a); 龚等, 2026 ).
主要依靠二维图像监督的方法(Chen等人,2024a); Song et al., 2025)对物体-场景几何缺乏直接约束,因此难以指导对目标视角的适应和姿势.

blocks.en: We propose PhysInsert , a framework combining counterfactual scene data, geometric priors, and spatial guidance for physically plausible object insertion.
blocks.zh: 我们提议将反事实场景数据、几何前题和空间指导结合起来, 进行物理上可行的物体插入。

blocks.en:
To provide counterfactual supervision for object–scene adaptation, we construct InsertWorld from strictly aligned pairs rendered by changing only object presence in complete scenes, capturing both scene-dependent object appearance and object-induced environmental changes.
Object references rendered across lighting environments and viewpoints support cross-environment and cross-view adaptation.
Paired with spatial instructions, these examples support text-guided control of placement and complex interactions with existing scene objects.
blocks.zh:
为了提供对对象-场景适应的反事实监督,我们通过改变完全场景中只存在的物体,捕捉到场景所依赖的物体外观和物体引起的环境变化,从完全对齐的对称构造InformWorld。
跨照明环境和观点提供的对象参考支持跨环境和跨视角的适应。
这些例子带有空间指示,支持以文字指导方式控制位置和与现有场景物体的复杂互动。

blocks.en:
To align object perspective and pose with the scene’s 3D structure, Geometry-Guided Adaptation models post-insertion geometry as a supervised intermediate representation.
Initialized from background VGGT features, a dedicated geometry stream evolves through joint attention with image and text tokens, with its feature readouts supervised against VGGT features of the with-object scene.
The geometry stream remains active at inference to guide scene-consistent object adaptation.
blocks.zh:
将对象视角与场景的3D结构对齐,几何引导的适应模型后插入几何作为受监督的中间代表.
从背景VGGT特征初始化,专用几何流通过与图像和文本符的联注演化,其特征读取被监视在与对象场景的VGGT特征上.
几何流依然活跃在推论中,以指导场景一致的物体适应.

blocks.en: To localize insertion-induced changes and ground spatial instructions in the image, we complement geometric adaptation with two forms of 2D supervision. Counterfactual Object–Scene Supervision uses object masks and aligned scene pairs to jointly supervise object occupancy and external effects. Soft-Mask Spatial Grounding aligns image–text attention with the object region to translate spatial instructions into placement control while retaining the full background input.
blocks.zh: 为了将插入引发的变化和图像中的地面空间指示定位,我们用两种2D监督形式补充几何适应. 反事实对象–场景监督使用对象口罩和对齐的场景配对,共同监督物体占用和外部效果. 软掩码空间 定位将图像-文本的注意力与对象区域对齐,以便在保留全部背景输入的同时将空间指令转化为放置控制.

blocks.en: To evaluate scene adaptation beyond appearance copying, we construct PhysInsert-Bench with cases requiring illumination or pose adaptation and include text-guided and real-world evaluations.
blocks.zh: 为了评价外观复制以外的场景适应,我们用需要照明或进行适应的病例构建物理Insert-Bench,并包括文字指导和现实世界的评价。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows: • Dataset: InsertWorld combines strictly aligned counterfactual scene pairs, cross-view and cross-lighting object references, and spatial instructions to support learning object adaptation and complex object–scene interactions. • Method: PhysInsert combines a background-initialized geometry stream supervised toward post-insertion scene features with 2D supervision, improving cross-environment and cross-view insertion and text-guided placement. • Benchmark: PhysInsert-Bench tests illumination and pose adaptation beyond appearance copying through dedicated cross-environment, cross-view, and in-the-wild cases.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下: ^ 数据集:Inform World结合了严格对齐的反事实场景对,交叉视图和交叉亮度对象参考,以及空间指令,支持学习对象适应和复杂对象–场景交互. • 支助 方法:PhysInsert将一个背景初始几何流与2D监督结合,监督后插入场景特征,改善跨环境及交叉视图插入和文字指导放置. • 支助 基准:物理Insert-Bench测试照明,并通过专用的跨环境、交叉视图和内层病例,在外观复制之外提出适应。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Recent work has sought to improve the physical plausibility of image editing by modeling scene geometry and physical interactions.
PhysicEdit ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) learns video-based transition priors to model causal physical changes in instruction-based editing.
PhyEdit ( Xu et al., 2026 ) relocates existing objects within a scene using geometric guidance and depth supervision.
Object3DIT ( Michel et al., 2023 ) supports language-guided translation, rotation, insertion, and removal in procedurally rendered scenes; its insertion specifies objects through text rather than external reference images.
Our task requires preserving a reference object’s identity while adapting its viewpoint, illumination, and interactions to a new scene.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作试图通过模拟场景几何和物理互动来提高图像编辑的物理可信度.
PhysicEdit(Zhao等人,2026年)在教学编辑中学习基于视频的过渡前期模型因果物理变化.
PhyEdit(Xu 等人,2026年)利用几何制导和深度监督,将现场内现存物体迁移.
Object3DIT(Michel et al., 2023)支持语言指导翻译,旋转,插入,以及在程序制作的场景中移除;其插入通过文本而不是外部参考图像指定对象.
我们的任务要求保留一个参考对象的身份,同时调整其观点、照明和互动,以适应新的场景。

blocks.en:
For supervision, ObjectDrop ( Winter et al., 2024 ) and OmniPaint ( Yu et al., 2025 ) use real counterfactual pairs, supplemented by generated bootstrapping or insertion–removal cycles.
ObjectMate ( Winter et al., 2025 ) and Insert-Anything ( Song et al., 2025 ) construct backgrounds through learned editing, whose accuracy depends on the editor; PS-Diffusion ( Wang et al., 2025b ) uses rendered pairs.
For control, mask-based methods ( Yang et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024a ; Yu et al., 2025 ) discard background information within the editing region, while ObjectMate uses boxes, Insert-Anything also supports text guidance, and DIRECT ( Gong et al., 2026 ) requires 3D proxy reconstruction and placement for pose control.
For viewpoint adaptation, Paint by Example derives same-image references, PS-Diffusion retains the target viewpoint, and ObjectDrop preserves pasted-object pose and illumination; AnyDoor, Insert-Anything, and ObjectMate incorporate multiview data.
PhysInsert combines controlled counterfactual rendering and diverse references with supervised geometry states, object–effect supervision, and spatial-text grounding.
blocks.zh:
在监督方面,ObjectDrop(Winter等人,2024年)和OmniPaint(Yu等人,2025年)使用真实的反事实对,辅之以生成的靴子或插入-清除周期。
ObjectMate(Winter等人,2025年)和Inform-Anything(Song等人,2025年)通过学习编辑构建背景,其准确性取决于编辑器;PS-Diffusion(Wang等人,2025年b)使用制成对.
用于控制,基于面具的方法 (Yang等人,2023年;Chen等人,2024a年;Yu等人,2025年)在编辑区域内丢弃背景资料,ObjectMate则使用方框,插入-任何东西也支持文本指导,DIRECT(Gong等人,2026年)则需要3D代理重建并放置以进行姿势控制.
对于视角的修改,Paint by Electric获得相同图像的引用,PS-Diffusion保留目标视角,ObjectDrop保存粘贴对象的姿势和照明; AnyDoor, Intent-Anything,以及ObjectorMate包含多视图数据.
PhysInsert 结合了受控反事实渲染和多样的引用,与受监督的几何状态,物体-效果监督,以及空间文本地面.

blocks.en: 3.2 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集建设

blocks.en: To reduce interpenetration and floating artifacts from random placement, we construct InsertWorld by removing existing objects from complete BlenderKit scenes (Figure 2 ). We render each scene with and without the object under fixed camera, lighting, and remaining scene settings, recomputing its shadows, mirror images, and reflections. These strictly aligned counterfactual pairs capture scene-dependent object appearance and object-induced environmental changes. Quality filtering and object deduplication retain suitable scene–object combinations.
blocks.zh: 为了减少随机放置的互渗透和漂浮文物,我们通过从完整的BlenderKit场景(图2 )中移除现有的对象来构建InformWorld. 我们用固定的相机 照明 和其余的场景设置 使每个场景 都带有和没有物体 这些严格对齐的反事实对捕捉到场景依赖的对象外观和物体引起的环境变化. 质量过滤和对象分解保留合适的场景–对象组合.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of InsertWorld construction and PhysInsert-Bench composition.
blocks.zh: 图2:InformationWorld构造与物理Insert-Bench构成概述.

blocks.en: We augment scene viewpoints and independently render each retained object across lighting environments and viewpoints to provide references for cross-environment and cross-view adaptation. Each example combines an object-free background, a with-object target, and reference images with Gemini-generated annotations comprising an editing instruction, a placement description, and a target-pose description. Filtering and sampling details are provided in Appendix I .
blocks.zh: 我们增加了场景视角,并独立地使每个保留物体跨越照明环境和观点,为跨环境和跨视的适应提供参考。 每个例子结合一个无对象背景,一个有对象目标,以及参考图像与双子座生成的说明,包括编辑指令,放置描述,以及目标pose描述. 筛选和取样的细节载于附录一。

blocks.en: 3.3 Dataset Overview
blocks.zh: 3.3 数据集概览

blocks.en: The InsertWorld training set contains 12,951 counterfactual scene image pairs and 275,310 reference images of 1,710 objects spanning different viewpoints and lighting conditions. For evaluation, PhysInsert-Bench comprises 400 cases from 103 scenes with no overlap with the training scenes and object, including 180 Optical cases (154 with aligned reference–target viewpoints and 26 cross-view challenges) and 220 Structural cases with independent reference viewpoints. Benchmark construction is detailed in § 4.2 .
blocks.zh: "插入世界"训练集包含12,951对反事实场景图像配对和275,310个参考图像,包含1,710个跨越不同视角和照明条件的物体. 为了评价,PhysInsert-Bench由103场景中的400个案例组成,与培训场景和物体没有重叠,包括180个光学案例(154个具有一致的参考-目标观点和26个交叉观点挑战)和220个结构案例,具有独立的参考观点。 基准建设详情见第4.2节。

blocks.en: 4 PhysInsert Model
blocks.zh: 4 物理演化模型

blocks.en: This section introduces our geometry-conditioned object insertion model and then describes the construction of PhysInsert-Bench.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍我们的几何条件对象插入模型,然后描述PhysInsert-Bench的构造.

blocks.en: Given an object-free background I − I_{-} , reference-object images ℐ r = { I r i } i = 1 N r \mathcal{I}_{r}=\{I_{r}^{i}\}_{i=1}^{N_{r}} , and an instruction p p , we aim to generate the with-object image I + I_{+} while preserving object identity and adapting both the object and its environmental effects to the target scene.
4.1 Geometry-Conditioned Object Insertion
blocks.zh: 4.1 几何条件对象插入

blocks.en: Our method combines Geometry-Guided Adaptation (GGA) for scene-consistent object adaptation with 2D Object–Scene Spatial Supervision (2D-OSS) for object regions, environmental changes, and spatial-text alignment (Figure 3 ). In our Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 backbone, the image stream U 0 U_{0} contains the noisy target latent and frozen-VAE encodings of the complete background and references; a frozen multimodal encoder produces text tokens T 0 T_{0} from the instruction and image context. Implementation and loss details are provided in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 我们的方法将几何-定向适应(GGA)用于场景一致的物体适应与2D对象-场景空间监督(2D-OSS)用于物体区域、环境变化和空间文本对齐(图3)。 在我们的Quen-Image-Edit-2511主干线中,图像流 U 0 U_{0}包含整个背景和参考文献的吵闹目标潜伏和冷冻的VAE编码;一个被冻结的多式联运编码器从指令和图像上下文中产生文字符号T 0 T_{0}. 执行情况和损失详情见附录E。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : PhysInsert combines a VGGT geometry stream with image and text streams. Target-scene features supervise geometry-token states, while 2D-OSS aligns object/effect predictions and spatial-text attention with image regions. Auxiliary supervision is used only during training.
blocks.zh: 图3: PhysInsert结合了VGGT几何流与图像和文本流. 目标-场景特征监督几何-托肯状态,而2D-OSS则将对象/效果预测和空间-文字关注与图像区域相配合. 辅助监督只在培训期间使用。

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Geometry-Guided Adaptation
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 几何指南适应

blocks.en: To guide scene-consistent object adaptation, GGA initializes a dynamic geometry stream from background features F − F_{-} extracted by frozen VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025a ) . An MLP A ϕ A_{\phi} maps these features to the DiT hidden space, with a learned geometry-modality embedding e G e_{G} . blocks.en: As shown in Figure 2 (b), PhysInsert-Bench evaluates optical and spatial–pose adaptation using aligned counterfactual scene pairs. Optical cases emphasize illumination differences and visible object-induced scene changes; their challenge cases and Structural cases additionally provide independent reference viewpoints to test pose adaptation. Each case is annotated for bidirectional interactions in lighting, spatial relationships, and pose, with physical-effect labels and evaluation-focus tags identifying the effects emphasized by that case.

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Our method builds upon Qwen-Image-Edit-2511, a DiT-based image editing model, retaining its pretrained Qwen2.5-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) multimodal encoder and VAE and adding a VGGT geometry stream alongside the image and text streams. We fine-tune the DiT using LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) with a rank of 32. Training is performed with a batch size of 8 and a maximum training-image pixel count of 1024 2 1024^{2} . We use the AdamW optimizer ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and a weight decay of 0.01 0.01 . All experiments are conducted on eight NVIDIA L20X GPUs. We train our model in a single stage on our proposed InsertWorld dataset for approximately 16,000 steps. At inference, we use 40 denoising steps and a CFG ( Ho and Salimans, 2022 ) scale of 4.0. Full training and inference hyperparameters are provided in Appendix F .

The Wild set draws on ABO ( Collins et al., 2022 ) , NAVI v1.5 ( Jampani et al., 2023 ) , ORIDa ( Kim et al., 2025 ) , and real target images paired with reference views rendered from SAM 3D Objects ( Chen et al., 2026 ) reconstructions. We favor reference poses that differ from the target pose to test cross-view adaptation; construction details are provided in Appendix I.2 .

blocks.en: We use PSNR and SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , and FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) to evaluate full-image fidelity, and DINO-Obj. to assess object identity preservation. Following PhyEdit ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , we use DIoU to measure object placement with a center-distance penalty, while Mask IoU measures visible-object overlap, including differences in visible extent caused by occlusion. AbsRel and δ 1.25 \delta_{1.25} assess estimated object-region depth consistency as a proxy for geometric plausibility. We also adapt the VLM-based physical plausibility evaluation of PhyEdit ( Xu et al., 2026 ) as Phy-VLM, using GPT-5.5 with a fixed prompt template augmented by each case’s physical-effect annotations and evaluation-focus tags (§ 4.2 ). These tags direct attention to the physical effects emphasized by that case. Metric definitions and implementation details are provided in Appendix D .

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented PhysInsert, combining InsertWorld’s counterfactual scene pairs and references across viewpoints and lighting with a VGGT geometry stream and 2D object–scene supervision for joint object and scene adaptation. PhysInsert-Bench and PhysInsert-Bench-Wild evaluate controlled adaptation and real-world generalization. Experiments demonstrate improved image fidelity and placement, supporting joint modeling of objects and their surroundings for physically plausible insertion.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了PhysInsert,结合了Inform World的反事实场景对和跨视线和照明的参考,并配有VGGT几何流和2D对象-场景监督,用于联合对象和场景的适应。 PhysInsert-Bench和PhysInsert-Bench-Wild评价受控适应和现实世界的概括. 实验表明图像忠贞度和位置得到改进,支持对物体及其周围进行联合建模,以便进行物理上可行的插入。

blocks.en: PhysInsert does not explicitly optimize for object identity preservation. Its ability to preserve identity remains limited when the reference and target viewpoints differ substantially. blocks.en: We apply one fixed evaluator to all methods on the same N = 400 N=400 original text-guided cases. Qwen3.5-Plus receives, in order, the input background, the object-reference collage, and the generated image. Using the editing instruction and a component vocabulary fixed per case across methods, it localizes all visible newly inserted target instances and parts, excluding pre-existing background objects, cast shadows, and reflections. Reference panels depict views of the same target assembly rather than additional copies. The grounder returns component boxes in x ​ y ​ x ​ y xyxy coordinates normalized to [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] , with temperature 0 and a requested maximum of 8192 output tokens. Neither GT RGB images nor GT masks or boxes are provided to localization or segmentation.
blocks.zh: 我们对所有同一N=400N=400的原始文本制导案例采用固定评估方法。 Quen3.5-Plus按顺序接收输入背景,对象参考拼接,以及生成的图像. 它使用编辑指令和每个案例固定的组件词汇,将所有可见的新插入的目标实例和部分本地化,不包括先前存在的背景对象,投影,反射. 参考小组描述的是同一目标组装的意见,而不是其他副本。 地面器返回xy xy xyxy坐标的组件框,正态化为 [0, 1000] [0, 1000],温度0,要求的最大输出符号为8192. GT RGB 图像或 GT 口罩或盒子均不提供给本地化或分区化.

blocks.en: RGB images are resized bilinearly to a shared canvas preserving the background aspect ratio, with longest side at most 1024 pixels. The reference collage preserves its own aspect ratio with the same size cap. VLM inputs are encoded as RGB JPEGs with quality 95 and no chroma subsampling. SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) ( facebook/sam3 ) generates candidates for each component phrase, using score and mask-probability thresholds of 0.5 and discarding masks smaller than 16 pixels. For each VLM box, we select every same-component candidate whose tight-box center lies inside that box and at least half of whose mask pixels lie inside it. If no candidate meets both conditions, we select the existing same-component candidate with highest box DIoU to the VLM box, retaining negative match scores. If that component has no candidates, we retry its category head noun (preserving “bean bag” as a phrase); if still unmatched, SAM3’s box-prompt tracker supplies a single mask with logit threshold 0. Selected masks are united into M ^ n \widehat{M}_{n} . Model weights remain in float32 with bfloat16 autocasting and TF32 enabled. blocks.en: D.5 VLM-Based Physical Plausibility

blocks.en: We adapt the VLM-based physical plausibility assessment in PhyEdit ( Xu et al., 2026 ) to PhysInsert-Bench, using GPT-5.5 to evaluate the outputs of all compared methods on the same 400 cases. Each evaluation prompt combines a fixed template with the case’s annotated physical effects and evaluation-focus tags from Appendix I.1 . The tags specify which physical effects warrant particular attention, such as illumination adaptation, cast shadows, reflections, or occlusion relationships, as applicable to the case. The same template and case-specific tag information are used across methods. For each method and case, we obtain three valid numerical ratings, retrying any evaluation that returns null until three valid ratings are available. No case is excluded because of a null response. We first average the three valid ratings within each case, then average these case-level scores equally over all 400 cases. We report the resulting Phy-VLM mean with the half-width of its 95% confidence interval; higher values indicate greater physical plausibility as judged by the VLM.
blocks.zh: 我们将基于VLM的PhyEdit(Xu等人,2026年)物理可信度评估修改为PhysInsert-Bench,使用GPT-5.5来评价相同400个案例上所有比较方法的输出. 每次评价都把固定模板与案件附加说明的物理效果和附录一.1中的评价重点标记结合起来。 标签具体说明哪些物理效果值得特别注意,例如照明适应、投影、反射或隔离关系,视具体情况而定。 同样的模板和具体案例的标记信息被跨方法使用. 对于每一种方法和案例,我们获得三个有效的数值评级,重新测试任何返回无效的评价,直到有三个有效的评级为止。 没有任何案件因答复无效而被排除。 我们首先在每个案件中平均三个有效的评分,然后在所有400个案件中平均这些案件一级的评分相等。 我们报告由此产生的 Phy-VLM , 其置信间隔为 95% 的半宽; 较高的值表明 VLM 判断的物理可信度更高 。

The background and reference object are provided only to aid understanding. First compare against the GT and separately verify the physical relationships in the GT and the result. This rule takes precedence over size requirements in the case annotations and the instruction. Evaluate only gravitational relationships (support, contact, and hanging), optical relationships (illumination, environmental color, shadows, reflections, and transmission), and geometric relationships (perspective, orientation, occlusion, and interpenetration). Do not separately penalize object size or changes in shadow or reflection extent that naturally result from it; do not infer errors in these relationships solely from a size difference. Large discrepancies from the GT in key physical relationships must receive a low score; appearance or size differences alone do not count. A clearly visible, severe gravitational, optical, or geometric error outside the stated focus caps the score at 2. Assign 1 for an entirely unsupported floating object, a disconnected primary load-bearing contact, obvious interpenetration, or impossible occlusion. Minor issues outside the focus do not reduce the score. Proximity or overlapping contours do not establish load-bearing support; any deduction must be supported by visible evidence. Return null when key evidence is unclear or the GT contains an obvious error that affects the judgment; do not automatically treat such cases as good or bad. blocks.en: Appendix I Dataset Construction Details
blocks.zh: 附录一 数据集构建细节

blocks.en:
We randomly select candidate objects from complete BlenderKit scenes and render counterfactual pairs under fixed camera, lighting, and remaining scene settings, recomputing shadows, mirror images, and reflections after removal. Rule-based filtering first rejects pairs with excessively small or large image changes. Gemini then examines the scene pair and object views for object completeness, background plausibility after removal, image quality, and realism, excluding unsuitable scene structures, residual semantic parts, and visible rendering artifacts. We deduplicate retained objects using DINO feature similarity while retaining their associated scenes.
The complete Gemini quality-scoring and interaction-classification prompts, including image order and JSON output examples, are reproduced in Appendix J.1 .
blocks.zh:
我们随机从完整的BlenderKit场景中选择候选对象,并在固定的相机下渲染反事实对,照明,以及剩余场景设置,重制阴影,镜像,以及移除后的反射. 基于规则的过滤首先拒绝图像变化过小或太大的对子. 双子座然后检查场景对面和对象视图,以了解物体的完整性,移除后的背景可信度,图像质量,以及现实性,不包括不适当的场景结构,剩余语义部分,以及可见的渲染文物. 我们在保留相关场景的同时,利用DINO来复制保留的对象具有相似性。
完整的双子座质量评分和交互分类提示,包括图像顺序和JSON输出示例,在附录J.1中转载.

blocks.en: For each retained scene–object combination, we keep the object and scene configuration unchanged while randomly varying the camera position. At each viewpoint, we rerender a matched with/without pair and apply a second quality check.
blocks.zh: 对于每个保留的场景-对象组合,我们保持对象和场景配置不变,同时随机改变相机位置. 在每个角度,我们重置一个配对/无配对,并应用第二个质量检查。

blocks.en: Each deduplicated object is independently rendered under seven lighting conditions: fixed white light, fixed studio lighting, and five randomly sampled HDR environments. For each condition, we use 11 fixed and 12 random viewpoints while preserving object geometry and material, yielding 7 × 23 = 161 7\times 23=161 reference images per object. These references are associated with the corresponding scene pairs.
blocks.zh: 每个变质物体在七个照明条件下独立渲染:固定白光,固定工作室照明,以及五个随机抽样的HDR环境. 对于每个条件,我们使用11个固定和12个随机角度,同时保存物体几何和材料,生成7×23=161 7\times 23=161参考图像每个物体. 这些参考文献与相应的场景配对相关.

CF denotes object-presence/absence pairs acquired through controlled capture or physical re-rendering under otherwise fixed settings; MV/ML denote same-object multiview/multilight data, and Ctrl. denotes control inputs. A blue check mark indicates that the corresponding data is provided; a red cross indicates that it is not specifically constructed; Partial indicates partial coverage.

blocks.en: I.1 Controlled Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 一.1 控制下的基准建设

blocks.en: Each controlled PhysInsert-Bench example contains an object-free background I − I_{-} , a reference set ℐ r \mathcal{I}_{r} , an insertion instruction p p , the corresponding with-object target I + I_{+} , and the target object region. The target box is the 2D bounding box enclosing the object rendered in Blender at its target pose. For box guidance, an additional reference image annotated with this box is supplied as visual conditioning, alongside the object-reference images. The object-reference counts reported in the tables do not include this additional box-annotated image. Text guidance instead uses spatial instructions describing position, scale, orientation, and occlusion relationships without an inference-time mask.
blocks.zh: 每个受控 PhysInsert-Bench 示例包含一个无对象背景 I − I_{- },一个参考集 I r\ mathcal{I}_{r},一个插入指令 p , 对应的与对象目标 I + I_{+} , 以及目标对象区域. 目标箱是2D边框,内装以Blender形式在目标姿势下渲染的物体。 对于框导引,附加此框注释的参考图像会作为视觉条件提供,同时提供对象参考图像. 表格中列报的对象参考数不包括这个附加框附加说明的图像. 文本指导则使用空间指示来描述位置,尺度,方向,以及隐蔽关系,而不带推论时间面具.

blocks.en: Each case also carries physical-effect labels and evaluation-focus tags, which specify the interactions emphasized by that example and are incorporated into the fixed Phy-VLM prompt. Interaction annotations describe scene-to-object requirements in illumination, visibility, and placement, and object-to-scene effects including cast shadows, reflections, mirror images, and occlusion changes. Optical cases combine substantial reference–target illumination differences with visible environmental effects. Spatial & Mechanical cases and 26 Optical challenges provide independent reference viewpoints to test scene-dependent orientation or pose adaptation.
blocks.zh: 每个案例还带有物理效应标签和评价焦点标记,这些标记具体说明了该例子所强调的相互作用,并纳入了固定的Phy-VLM提示。 相互作用说明在照明、可见度和位置方面描述了场景对物体的要求,以及物体对场景的影响,包括投影、反射、镜像和隐蔽变化。 光学案例结合了大量参考-目标照明差异和可见的环境影响。 空间和机械案例以及26个光学挑战提供了独立的参考观点,用于测试场景依赖方向或提出适应。

blocks.zh: I.2 真实世界测试设备的建造

blocks.en: We construct 40 test cases covering all objects in DreamBooth. For each case, we randomly select one image as the target and use the remaining images of the same object as the reference pool; we report one-reference evaluation. We remove the object from the target image using Nano Banana Pro and manually review the resulting background.
blocks.zh: 我们建造了40个测试箱 覆盖了DreamBooth的所有物体 对于每个案例,我们随机选择一个图像作为目标,并使用与参考集合相同的对象的剩余图像;我们报告一个参考评价. 我们使用 Nano Banana Pro 从目标图像中删除对象,并手动审查由此产生的背景。

blocks.en: The 50 cases draw on Amazon Berkeley Objects (ABO) ( Collins et al., 2022 ) , NAVI v1.5 ( Jampani et al., 2023 ) , the training and validation splits of ORIDa ( Kim et al., 2025 ) , and real images with references generated using SAM 3D Objects ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Reference pools contain multiview product images from ABO, multiview photographs of the same object from NAVI, and cross-scene observations of the same object from ORIDa. For the SAM 3D-based cases, we use real target images and render reference views from SAM 3D Objects reconstructions.

These prompts inspect rendered training-data candidates, not predictions from the methods compared in our result tables. Both produce a short insertion caption ( insertion_description ) as part of a structured JSON response; this caption is distinct from the full editing prompt used to condition the generation model. The wording and example responses below are preserved, with only typographic reformatting. The JSON examples are part of the prompts, not measured sample annotations.

blocks.en: Stage 1 assigns six integer scores in [ 0 , 5 ] [0,5] : object validity, three-view quality, insertion-result validity, image realism, insertion difficulty, and overall quality. Difficulty rewards useful complexity but must not compensate for severe quality failures. Stage 2 retains an image-realism score, assigns relative scale and mechanical type, and records seven scene-interaction attributes. Mechanical interaction and lighting/shadow complexity use integer levels 0 / 1 / 2 0/1/2 ; the other five interaction fields are Boolean. These are evidence-based annotations, not mutually exclusive benchmark-subset labels. In particular, a visible change in the amplified difference map is not sufficient evidence of a reflection without confirmation in the original scene pair.
blocks.zh: 第1阶段在 [0, 5] [0, 5] 中分配六个整数分数 : 对象有效性,三视图质量,插入效果有效性,图像现实主义,插入难度,以及整体质量. 困难奖励了有用的复杂性,但绝不能补偿严重的质量失误。 第2阶段保留了图像现实主义的分数,分配了相对尺度和机械类型,并记录了七个场景交互属性. 机械交互和照明/阴影复杂度使用整数级0 / 1 / 2 0/1/2;其他五个交互域为布尔. 这些是循证说明,而不是相互排斥的基准子集标签. 特别是,放大差异图的明显变化,在原始场景配对中未经确认,不足以证明反射.

blocks.en: J.1.1 Stage 1: Six-Dimension Quality Scoring
blocks.zh: J.1.1 第一阶段:六分法 质量计数

blocks.en: Prompt S1: Quality scoring — complete request text You are a senior quality-control expert for 3D object-insertion training data. You will receive 6 images and must judge whether this sample is suitable for object-insertion training. [Inputs] - Image 1: with, the result after inserting the object. - Image 2: without, the background before insertion. - Image 3: removed_only, an isolated rendering of the object to be inserted. - Image 4: front view of the object. - Image 5: right view of the object. - Image 6: top view of the object. [Task] 1. Describe the sample from the insertion perspective: "insert [object] at [location]". Treat Image 1 as the result of inserting the object shown in Images 3-6 into the scene in Image 2. If the object cannot be identified, write "unclear insertion object". 2. Score the following 6 dimensions from 0 to 5, where 5 is best. Use Images 3-6 especially for object_validity and three_view_quality, and compare Images 1-2 especially for insertion_result_validity. 3. Output JSON keys must be English exactly as specified. Chinese labels below are only references. If the inserted object is unclear, insertion_description must be "unclear insertion object", and all six scores must be 0. [Dimensions] 1. object_validity - Judge whether the target is a reasonable independent object or a tightly bound object group. - Reasonable examples: cups, chairs, flowerpots, lamps, curtains, wire mesh, hanging ornaments, decorative objects, or strongly bound small parts. - Unreasonable examples: walls, floors, ceilings, large background regions, large cabinet/room structures, or structural surfaces that change the whole scene. - If removed_only or the three views show a wall, floor, ceiling, or huge background structure, score <= 1. - Curtains, rugs, wire mesh, railings, hanging screens, etc. may be large but can still be valid if they are semantically independent insertable objects. - Thin disk-like or sheet-like objects such as coasters, pads, washers, thin trays, dials, rugs, and similar items are valid when they have clear semantics or physical relations, such as a cup-coaster support/contact relation. Do not give a low score only because they are thin. - The inserted target should preferably be one object or a semantically coherent object group. Spatial separation is acceptable when the objects form one continuous semantic unit or a natural arrangement, such as a row of chairs. However, if the target contains multiple disconnected object groups placed in different unrelated regions, such as several groups of books in different compartments of a bookshelf, score <= 2. 2. three_view_quality - Judge whether Images 4-6 provide enough clear, learnable information about the inserted object. - At least one or more views should clearly show the object’s outline, scale, orientation, part relationship, or key material information. Penalize if all three views are blurry, overexposed, too dark, too small, heavily cropped, or nearly duplicate the same view. - Do not give a low score just because one or two views look like a line. Flat objects such as disks, coasters, pads, thin boards, trays, and dials naturally look line-like from front/side views. If the top view or another view clearly shows the shape, and the object has clear semantics or a physical relation, this dimension can be medium or high. - If at least one three-view image provides enough information, for example a coaster/disk/dial shape is clear in top view, the score should usually be >= 3. - Score <= 2 only when all three views provide little useful information, or when the object is extremely thin/long and lacks learnable shape, material, or semantic information, such as a very thin railing/rod/cable. 3. insertion_result_validity - Focus on Image 2 without: whether it is suitable as the pre-insertion background. The sample was constructed by deletion, so with is usually more reliable and without is more likely to contain artifacts. - Core check: whether Image 2 still contains parts that belong to the same semantic object, same object group, or strongly bound components of the inserted object. For a flowerpot, without should not leave leaves/soil/tray from the same plant; for a pendant lamp, without should not leave the lampshade/bulb/wire/rod of the same lamp. - If unrelated objects in without are floating, structurally odd, abstract, or physically unnatural, but they are not the same semantic object/group and not strongly bound to the inserted object, do not heavily penalize this dimension. - Penalize this dimension only when without has same-object residuals, same-group residuals, strongly bound residual parts, or an obvious hole/break at the insertion region that makes it unusable as a pre-insertion background. - If Image 1 contains an obvious violation of physical plausibility in an otherwise highly realistic scene, such as a clearly floating object in an indoor environment, or if the inserted object has physically implausible mesh penetration with the scene, the score for this dimension should be <= 2. - If the difference between the Image 1 and Image 2 is too small, such as when the inserted object is heavily occluded or visually too similar to the surrounding environment, making the insertion result difficult to identify, the score for this dimension should be <= 2. 4. image_realism - Judge whether Images 1 and 2 contain rendering or geometry quality problems that make the sample unusable. Do not simply penalize the scene for being stylized or abstract. - Acceptable: minimal abstract geometry scenes, simple 3D style, unrelated floating objects in without, unrelated physically unnatural context, or small black rendering artifacts outside the object insertion region that do not affect insertion quality. - Accept reasonable contact, support, attachment, or slight embedding between an object and its support, such as a cup on a coaster or an object attached to a pad/base. Do not label such physical contact as mesh penetration. - Penalize: severe visible mesh penetration, broken geometry, abnormal faces, wrong-normal black/bright faces, obviously wrong material rendering, abnormal exposure or lighting, large black/blank image regions, large unintended solid-color backgrounds, or rendering collapse. - If the image contains large black unrendered regions, or if the scene lighting is so low that key scene information is difficult to recognize, the score should be <= 2. 5. insertion_difficulty - This is a bonus-like dimension. It measures whether the sample contains difficult but valuable insertion conditions. It must not hide severe failures in the basic dimensions above. - Difficulty has three categories: spatial complexity (occlusion, perspective deformation), physical complexity (size, support, tilt, suspension, contact), and lighting/material complexity (high contrast, strong shadows, reflection, self-emitting lamp-like objects, metal/transparent/glass/complex textures). - If the object is frontal, unoccluded, under simple lighting, with simple material and simple physical relation, difficulty should be low or medium. 6. overall_quality - Overall suitability for object-insertion training, considering the five dimensions above. - If any basic dimension among object_validity, three_view_quality, insertion_result_validity, and image_realism has a severe error, overall_quality must be low and cannot be rescued by high insertion_difficulty. - If the four basic dimensions have no severe problem, insertion_difficulty can boost overall_quality. High-quality high-difficulty samples can receive 5. Low-difficulty samples usually tend toward 3-4 unless the basic dimensions are exceptionally good. [Scoring Discipline] Be strict. Do not give 4 or 5 lightly; reserve high scores for samples with clearly strong evidence and no serious issues in the relevant dimensions. For each dimension, the reason must be specific: point out the problem location and problem type, and avoid vague generic comments. [Output Requirements] Return only one JSON object wrapped by “‘json and “‘. Do not output any extra text. The JSON object must contain exactly these top-level keys: insertion_description, object_validity, three_view_quality, insertion_result_validity, image_realism, insertion_difficulty, overall_quality, reason. reason must be a JSON object, not a string. It must contain exactly these six keys: object_validity, three_view_quality, insertion_result_validity, image_realism, insertion_difficulty, overall_quality. All six score values must be integers from 0 to 5. [Valid Output Template] { "insertion_description": "insert a white vase on the tabletop", "object_validity": 5, "three_view_quality": 4, "insertion_result_validity": 4, "image_realism": 4, "insertion_difficulty": 2, "overall_quality": 4, "reason": { "object_validity": "The target is an independent vase and is a reasonable insertable object.", "three_view_quality": "The three views clearly show the vase outline, volume, and material cues.", "insertion_result_validity": "The without image is usable and has no same-object residual parts around the insertion region.", "image_realism": "The scene has no severe rendering collapse, broken geometry, or obvious material errors.", "insertion_difficulty": "The object is mostly unoccluded with simple lighting and material, so the insertion difficulty is moderate to low.", "overall_quality": "The four basic dimensions are acceptable, but the task is not very difficult, so it is a usable regular training sample." } }

blocks.en: You are a senior quality-control expert for 3D object-insertion training data. You will receive 6 images and must judge whether this sample is suitable for object-insertion training.
blocks.zh: 您是3D 插入对象培训数据的高级质量控制专家 。 您将收到6个图像, 并且必须判断此样本是否适合对象插入训练 。

blocks.en: [Inputs]
blocks.zh: [投入]

blocks.en: - Image 1: with, the result after inserting the object.
blocks.zh: - 图1:插入对象后的结果。

blocks.en: - Image 2: without, the background before insertion.
blocks.zh: - 图2:没有,插入前的背景。

blocks.en: - Image 3: removed_only, an isolated rendering of the object to be inserted.
blocks.zh: - 图像 3: 仅删除, 将插入对象的孤立渲染 。

blocks.en: - Image 4: front view of the object.
blocks.zh: - 图像 4: 对象的前视图。

blocks.en: - Image 5: right view of the object.
blocks.zh: - 图5:物体的正确视图。

blocks.en: - Image 6: top view of the object.
blocks.zh: - 图像6:物体的顶部视图。

blocks.en: [Task]
blocks.zh: [任务]

blocks.en: 1. Describe the sample from the insertion perspective: "insert [object] at [location]". Treat Image 1 as the result of inserting the object shown in Images 3-6 into the scene in Image 2. If the object cannot be identified, write "unclear insertion object".
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 从插入角度描述样本:“在[位置]插入[对象]”。 将图像1作为将图像3-6显示的对象插入图像2的场景的结果处理. 如果无法识别对象,请写"不明确的插入对象".

blocks.en: 2. Score the following 6 dimensions from 0 to 5, where 5 is best. Use Images 3-6 especially for object_validity and three_view_quality, and compare Images 1-2 especially for insertion_result_validity.
blocks.zh: 2. 国家 将以下6个维度从0到5分评分,其中5分最好. 使用图像 3-6 , 特别是对象有效性和 3_视图质量, 并比较图像 1-2 , 特别是插入结果有效性 。

blocks.en: 3. Output JSON keys must be English exactly as specified. Chinese labels below are only references.
blocks.zh: 3个 输出 JSON 密钥必须完全按照指定的英文 。 以下中文标签仅供参考.

blocks.en: If the inserted object is unclear, insertion_description must be "unclear insertion object", and all six scores must be 0.
blocks.zh: 如果插入对象不明确,插入_描述必须是"不明确的插入对象",所有六个分数必须是0.

blocks.en: [Dimensions]
blocks.zh: [日

blocks.en: 1. object_validity
blocks.zh: 1. 无效性

blocks.en: - Judge whether the target is a reasonable independent object or a tightly bound object group.
blocks.zh: - 判断目标是否为合理的独立对象或严格约束对象群。

blocks.en: - Reasonable examples: cups, chairs, flowerpots, lamps, curtains, wire mesh, hanging ornaments, decorative objects, or strongly bound small parts.
blocks.zh: - 合理的例子:杯子、椅子、花盆、灯具、窗帘、铁丝网、悬挂装饰品、装饰品,或紧紧捆绑的小块。

blocks.en: - Unreasonable examples: walls, floors, ceilings, large background regions, large cabinet/room structures, or structural surfaces that change the whole scene.
blocks.zh: - 不合情理的例子:墙壁、地板、天花板、大背景区域、大柜/房间结构、或改变整个场景的结构表面。

blocks.en: - If removed_only or the three views show a wall, floor, ceiling, or huge background structure, score <= 1.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 如果只删除_或三种视图显示墙壁,地板,天花板,或巨大的背景结构,则得分QQ 1.

blocks.en: - Curtains, rugs, wire mesh, railings, hanging screens, etc. may be large but can still be valid if they are semantically independent insertable objects.
blocks.zh: - 窗帘、地毯、铁丝网、栏杆、吊屏等可能很大,但如果它们是可安装的独立物体,仍然有效。

blocks.en: - Thin disk-like or sheet-like objects such as coasters, pads, washers, thin trays, dials, rugs, and similar items are valid when they have clear semantics or physical relations, such as a cup-coaster support/contact relation. Do not give a low score only because they are thin.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 薄盘状或薄板状物体,如摩擦器,垫子,洗衣机,薄盘,拨号,地毯等,以及类似物品,当它们有明确的语义或物理关系时,如杯架支持/接触关系,都是有效的. 不只因为薄而给低分

blocks.en: - The inserted target should preferably be one object or a semantically coherent object group. Spatial separation is acceptable when the objects form one continuous semantic unit or a natural arrangement, such as a row of chairs. However, if the target contains multiple disconnected object groups placed in different unrelated regions, such as several groups of books in different compartments of a bookshelf, score <= 2.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 插入的目标最好是一个物体或一个整体一致的物体组。 当物体形成一个连续的语义单元或一排椅子等自然安排时,空间分离是可以接受的. 然而,如果目标包含多个被放置在不同不相关区域的断开对象组,如书架不同隔间中的几组图书,则得分QQ 2.

blocks.en: 2. three_view_quality
blocks.zh: 2. 三视图质量

blocks.en: - Judge whether Images 4-6 provide enough clear, learnable information about the inserted object.
blocks.zh: - 判断图像 4-6 是否为插入对象提供了足够清楚、可学习的信息。

blocks.en: - At least one or more views should clearly show the object’s outline, scale, orientation, part relationship, or key material information. Penalize if all three views are blurry, overexposed, too dark, too small, heavily cropped, or nearly duplicate the same view.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 至少有一种或多种观点应明确显示对象的大纲、尺度、方向、部分关系或关键材料信息。 如果所有三种观点都模糊,过度曝光,太暗,太小,收成严重,或者几乎重复相同观点,则予以处罚.

blocks.en: - Do not give a low score just because one or two views look like a line. Flat objects such as disks, coasters, pads, thin boards, trays, and dials naturally look line-like from front/side views. If the top view or another view clearly shows the shape, and the object has clear semantics or a physical relation, this dimension can be medium or high.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 不要仅仅因为一两个观点看起来像一行而给低分. 平面物体如磁盘,滑轮,垫子,薄板,托盘,以及拨号在前/侧视图中自然看起来类似线状. 如果顶部视图或其他视图清楚显示形状,且对象有明显的语义或物理关系,则这个维度可以是中或高的.

blocks.en: - If at least one three-view image provides enough information, for example a coaster/disk/dial shape is clear in top view, the score should usually be >= 3.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 如果至少一个三视图图像提供了足够信息,例如顶部视图中一个coder/disk/dial形状是清晰的,通常得分应为QQ. 3个

blocks.en: - Score <= 2 only when all three views provide little useful information, or when the object is extremely thin/long and lacks learnable shape, material, or semantic information, such as a very thin railing/rod/cable.
blocks.zh: - 只有在所有三种观点都提供很少有用的信息时,或当物体极薄/长,缺乏可学习的形状、材料或语义信息,如极薄的栏杆/可吸/可吸时,才得分。

blocks.en: 3. insertion_result_validity
blocks.zh: 3. 插入_效果_有效性

blocks.en: - Focus on Image 2 without: whether it is suitable as the pre-insertion background. The sample was constructed by deletion, so with is usually more reliable and without is more likely to contain artifacts.
blocks.zh: - 关注图像 2 不:它是否适合作为插入前的背景。 样本是通过删除方式构建的,因此通常使用更可靠,没有的更可能包含文物.

blocks.en: - Core check: whether Image 2 still contains parts that belong to the same semantic object, same object group, or strongly bound components of the inserted object. For a flowerpot, without should not leave leaves/soil/tray from the same plant; for a pendant lamp, without should not leave the lampshade/bulb/wire/rod of the same lamp.
blocks.zh: - 核心检查:图像2是否仍然包含属于同一语义对象,同一对象组的部件,或者插入对象的强约束部件. 对于一个花盆,不应留下同一植物的叶子/土壤/托盘;对于一个圆柱形的灯,不应留下同一灯的灯罩/柱/线/杆。

blocks.en: - If unrelated objects in without are floating, structurally odd, abstract, or physically unnatural, but they are not the same semantic object/group and not strongly bound to the inserted object, do not heavily penalize this dimension.
blocks.zh: - 如果不相关的物体在外是浮动的、结构奇异的、抽象的或物理上的不自然的,但是它们不是同一个语义对象/组,而且与插入的对象没有强烈的束缚,则不严重惩罚这个维度。

blocks.en: - Penalize this dimension only when without has same-object residuals, same-group residuals, strongly bound residual parts, or an obvious hole/break at the insertion region that makes it unusable as a pre-insertion background.
blocks.zh: - 只有在没有相同物体残余物、同组残余物、有强烈约束的残余物,或在插入区域有明显漏洞/破裂,使其无法用作预先插入的背景时,才惩罚这一方面。

blocks.en: - If Image 1 contains an obvious violation of physical plausibility in an otherwise highly realistic scene, such as a clearly floating object in an indoor environment, or if the inserted object has physically implausible mesh penetration with the scene, the score for this dimension should be <= 2.
blocks.zh: - 如果图像1包含在原本高度现实的场景中明显违反物理可信度,如室内环境中的明显漂浮物体,或者插入物体在物理上与场景的网状穿透不可信,则这个维度的得分应为QQ 2.

blocks.en: - If the difference between the Image 1 and Image 2 is too small, such as when the inserted object is heavily occluded or visually too similar to the surrounding environment, making the insertion result difficult to identify, the score for this dimension should be <= 2.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 如果图像1和图像2的区别太小,如插入对象被严重占用或视觉上与周围环境过于相似,使得插入结果难以识别,则此维度的得分应为QQ 2.

blocks.en: 4. image_realism
blocks.zh: 4. 形象-现实主义

blocks.en: - Judge whether Images 1 and 2 contain rendering or geometry quality problems that make the sample unusable. Do not simply penalize the scene for being stylized or abstract.
blocks.zh: - 判断图像1和2是否包含渲染或几何质量问题,使样品无法使用。 不要仅仅因为场景被定性或抽象而惩罚.

blocks.en: - Acceptable: minimal abstract geometry scenes, simple 3D style, unrelated floating objects in without, unrelated physically unnatural context, or small black rendering artifacts outside the object insertion region that do not affect insertion quality.
blocks.zh: - 可接受性:最小抽象几何场景,简单3D风格,无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无外无

blocks.en: - Accept reasonable contact, support, attachment, or slight embedding between an object and its support, such as a cup on a coaster or an object attached to a pad/base. Do not label such physical contact as mesh penetration.
blocks.zh: - 接受一个物体及其支持之间的合理接触、支持、附件或稍稍嵌入,例如放在垫/基上的杯子或附在垫/基上的物体。 不要将这种物理接触贴上网状插入的标签。

blocks.en: - Penalize: severe visible mesh penetration, broken geometry, abnormal faces, wrong-normal black/bright faces, obviously wrong material rendering, abnormal exposure or lighting, large black/blank image regions, large unintended solid-color backgrounds, or rendering collapse.
blocks.zh: - 惩罚:严重可见网状穿透、几何断裂、面部反常、黑/白脸不正常、材料渲染明显错误、曝光或照明异常、黑色/空白图像区域大、无意识的固体颜色背景大、或崩溃。

blocks.en: - If the image contains large black unrendered regions, or if the scene lighting is so low that key scene information is difficult to recognize, the score should be <= 2.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 如果画面中包含大片黑色未交接区域,或者如果场景照明率太低以至于关键场景信息难以识别,则得分应为QQ 2.

blocks.en: 5. insertion_difficulty
blocks.zh: 5. 插入_困难

blocks.en: - This is a bonus-like dimension. It measures whether the sample contains difficult but valuable insertion conditions. It must not hide severe failures in the basic dimensions above.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 这是一个像奖金的维度。 它衡量样本是否含有困难但有价值的插入条件。 它决不能掩盖上述基本方面的严重失败。

blocks.en: - Difficulty has three categories: spatial complexity (occlusion, perspective deformation), physical complexity (size, support, tilt, suspension, contact), and lighting/material complexity (high contrast, strong shadows, reflection, self-emitting lamp-like objects, metal/transparent/glass/complex textures).
blocks.zh: - 困难有三类:空间复杂度(隐蔽、视角变形)、物理复杂度(体积、支撑、倾斜、悬浮、接触)和照明/材料复杂度(高对比、强阴影、反射、自射灯状物体、金属/透明/玻璃/复合纹理)。

blocks.en: - If the object is frontal, unoccluded, under simple lighting, with simple material and simple physical relation, difficulty should be low or medium.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 如果物体是正面的,无遮蔽的,在简单的照明下,有简单的材料和简单的物理关系,那么难度应该是低的或中性的.

blocks.en: 6. overall_quality
blocks.zh: 6. 总质量

blocks.en: - Overall suitability for object-insertion training, considering the five dimensions above.
blocks.zh: - 考虑到上述五个方面,全面适合进行物体插入培训。

blocks.en: - If any basic dimension among object_validity, three_view_quality, insertion_result_validity, and image_realism has a severe error, overall_quality must be low and cannot be rescued by high insertion_difficulty.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 如果对象-有效性, 3_视图_质量, 插入_效果_有效性, 和图像- 现实主义之间有任何基本维度存在严重错误, 整体- 质量必须低, 并且无法通过高插入_ 难度来挽救 。

blocks.en: - If the four basic dimensions have no severe problem, insertion_difficulty can boost overall_quality. High-quality high-difficulty samples can receive 5. Low-difficulty samples usually tend toward 3-4 unless the basic dimensions are exceptionally good.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 如果四个基本维度没有严重的问题,插入_难度可以提升整体_质量. 可接收高质量的高难度样品 5. 低难度样品通常趋向于3-4,除非基本尺寸特别好。

blocks.en: [Scoring Discipline]
blocks.zh: [校规

blocks.en: Be strict. Do not give 4 or 5 lightly; reserve high scores for samples with clearly strong evidence and no serious issues in the relevant dimensions.
blocks.zh: 严谨. 不得轻取4或5分;为有明显有力证据且相关维度没有严重问题的样品预留高分.

blocks.en: For each dimension, the reason must be specific: point out the problem location and problem type, and avoid vague generic comments.
blocks.zh: 对于每个维度,理由必须具体:指出问题位置和问题类型,避免模糊的泛泛评论.

blocks.en: [Output Requirements]
blocks.zh: [产出要求]

blocks.en: Return only one JSON object wrapped by “‘json and “‘. Do not output any extra text.
blocks.zh: 只返回一个由“`json and'”包裹的JSON物体。 不输出任何额外文本 。

blocks.en: The JSON object must contain exactly these top-level keys: insertion_description, object_validity, three_view_quality, insertion_result_validity, image_realism, insertion_difficulty, overall_quality, reason.
blocks.zh: JSON 对象必须完全包含这些顶级密钥:插入_描述,对象_有效性,3_视图_质量,插入_效果_有效性,图像_现实主义,插入_难度,整体_质量,理由.

blocks.en: reason must be a JSON object, not a string. It must contain exactly these six keys: object_validity, three_view_quality, insertion_result_validity, image_realism, insertion_difficulty, overall_quality.

blocks.zh: 所有六个分值都必须是整数从0到5.
