blocks.en: J.1.2 Stage 2: Object Properties and Scene Interactions
blocks.zh: J.1.2 阶段2:物体属性和场景相互作用

blocks.en: Prompt S2: Interaction classification — complete request text You are a senior analyst of 3D object-insertion data. You will receive seven images describing one insertion case. Classify the inserted object and its interactions with the scene. Also retain an image-realism quality score. [Input images] - Image 1: with, the scene containing the target object. - Image 2: without, the same scene after removing the target object. - Image 3: removed_only, an isolated rendering of the complete removed object group. - Image 4: front view of the complete removed object group. - Image 5: right view of the complete removed object group. - Image 6: top view of the complete removed object group. - Image 7: signed environment difference map after masking the target object’s own pixels. Black means little or no detected change. Blue means the pre-existing scene became darker after insertion, red means it became brighter, and green means a mainly chromatic change with little luminance change. Intensity represents amplified change magnitude. Use it only to locate and type candidate changes, then verify their physical meaning in Images 1-2. Use Images 3-6 to identify intrinsic object properties. Compare Images 1 and 2 to identify object-environment relations. Do not infer a relation merely because it is theoretically possible. For boolean fields, mark true only with visible evidence. For 0/1/2 fields, choose a positive level only with visible evidence supporting that level. [Tasks] 1. Write insertion_description in the form "insert [object] at [location]". 2. Score image_realism from 0 to 5, where 5 is best. The inserted target must be correctly rendered in Image 1 (with). Check Images 1 and 2 for rendering collapse, broken or missing geometry, wrong normals, severe penetration, abnormal exposure, missing textures, genuinely unrendered regions, abnormal black target parts, and clearly incorrect material rendering. Stylized but internally consistent scenes are acceptable. - Judge rendering and geometry quality only to determine whether the insertion sample is visually usable. Do not lower image_realism merely because the scene is stylized, abstract, minimal, semantically unusual, or physically implausible in ways unrelated to the insertion. - Acceptable context includes minimal abstract geometry, a simple 3D rendering style, unrelated floating objects already present in without, unrelated physically unnatural scene content, and small isolated black rendering artifacts outside the target/insertion region when they do not affect insertion quality or interpretation. - Accept reasonable contact, support, attachment, and slight embedding between the target and its intended support, such as a cup resting on a coaster or an object attached to a pad/base. Do not call ordinary load-bearing contact, a tight attachment, or shallow support embedding severe mesh penetration. Penalize penetration only when geometry visibly passes through another surface by an implausible amount, produces broken/interleaved faces, or materially damages the target or support silhouette. - Quality problems include severe visible mesh penetration, broken or missing geometry, abnormal faces, wrong-normal black/bright faces, clearly incorrect material rendering, abnormal exposure or lighting, large black/blank unrendered regions, large unintended solid-color backgrounds, and partial or complete rendering collapse. - Large-black/low-light score cap: if Image 1 contains a large genuinely unrendered black/blank region, or scene illumination is so low that the target or key scene structure is difficult to recognize, image_realism must be 0, 1, or 2 and never higher. Use 2 when the sample remains usable despite the defect; use 0 or 1 when the blank region or darkness dominates, hides the target, or prevents reliable interpretation. This cap concerns missing content or unusable visibility, not physically plausible black materials or shadows. - Large unintended solid-color backgrounds of any color cap image_realism at 2 when they visibly replace expected scene content or indicate rendering failure. Apply the stricter flat-gray gate below when the failed region is a substantial near-uniform neutral gray area. - Mandatory target-integrity gate: first identify the target’s complete expected structure, parts, silhouette, and materials from removed_only and the front/right/top views. Then inspect every visible target region in with. The target must appear as a coherent rendered object: expected visible parts must exist, surfaces must be continuous, geometry must not look shattered, torn, erased, hollow, or accidentally clipped, and materials/textures must not be replaced by anomalous featureless black patches. Do not award 5 unless this target-integrity check clearly passes. - Mandatory target-visibility gate: compare with against removed_only and determine whether a meaningful, recognizable portion of the inserted target is actually visible in the scene image. If the target is almost invisible because it is nearly entirely outside the frame, hidden by scene geometry, reduced to only a tiny sliver or scattered fragments, extremely underexposed, or merged with the background so strongly that its silhouette and material cannot be judged, image_realism must be 0 or 1 and never 2 or higher. Use 0 when the target is effectively absent or cannot be reliably located in with; use 1 when only a tiny insufficient fragment or extremely weak trace remains. As a practical cue, visibility of roughly less than 10 percent of the expected projected target silhouette, or the absence of any coherent identifiable target part, normally triggers this rule. A physically small XS/S object is not a failure when it is still clearly resolved and recognizable. - Target-defect score caps: a clear but localized target rendering defect, such as a broken surface, missing small part, isolated invalid black patch, wrong-normal patch, texture dropout, or obvious unintended intersection, caps image_realism at 2. A widespread defect, a missing major target part, severe geometry collapse, or a black/corrupt region that materially prevents recognizing or judging the inserted target requires image_realism 0 or 1. A visible but milder suspicious artifact that does not clearly break geometry or materials caps the score at 3. - For target defects, one direct contradiction with removed_only or the three object views is sufficient evidence; do not require two independent indicators. Examples include an expected target surface becoming a featureless black hole, a target part abruptly disappearing without a foreground occluder, or a material region being replaced by black pixels whose boundary cuts across the target’s own geometry. This target-specific rule takes priority over the general black/gray-region rule below. - Mandatory flat-gray unrendered-region gate: if Image 1 contains a visually substantial region of nearly uniform neutral gray that is clearly empty/unrendered rather than scene geometry, image_realism must be 0 or 1 and never 2 or higher. The decisive evidence is a pure-color-like gray area with almost no texture, material detail, geometry, shading gradient, lighting variation, or physically meaningful structure, often ending at an artificial boundary or replacing an area where scene content should exist. This gate applies even when the gray region does not overlap the target and takes priority over the general non-target two-indicator rule below. Use 0 when the blank gray region dominates or makes the image unusable; otherwise use 1. - Do not confuse the flat-gray gate with darkness caused by the inserted object or scene lighting. A cast/contact shadow, shaded wall, gray material, fog, or underexposed surface remains valid when it preserves scene texture, geometry, gradual illumination or penumbra, material variation, reflections, or boundaries consistent with physical objects. A dark region is not a pure-gray unrendered region merely because it is large or low-contrast. - Dark pixels, a large black/gray area, low exposure, or contact with the image boundary are not by themselves rendering failures. Before lowering the score, first identify what geometry occupies that region using with, removed_only, and the three object views. Dark target materials, dark scene objects, fabric folds, physically plausible cast/contact shadows, naturally dark rooms, foreground objects close to the camera, and ordinary image-frame cropping are valid rendered content. - Evidence of valid rendering includes a coherent object silhouette, continuous geometry, material texture, fabric detail or folds, soft shading gradients, plausible shadow transitions, highlights, and boundaries that follow visible scene geometry. A dark region with any of these cues must not be called flat, blank, or unrendered merely because its average brightness is low. - General non-target hard failure rule: assign image_realism 0 or 1 for a black/gray/blank scene region only when there is positive visual evidence that rendering content is actually missing or corrupted and it materially prevents judging the target. For non-target/background regions, require at least two of these indicators: (a) the region is genuinely featureless with no geometry, texture, shading gradient, or plausible shadow structure; (b) it has an abrupt boundary that does not follow any object silhouette, occluder, image frame, or physical shadow; (c) it cuts through or replaces target parts that removed_only or the three views show should be visible; (d) it is inconsistent with the corresponding scene geometry in with/without; (e) it produces impossible holes, erased surfaces, or broken topology. This two-indicator requirement does not apply to a directly verified target defect under the target-integrity gate. A dark region appearing only in with is valid only when it is visibly coherent target material or shading, not merely because it overlaps the target location. - Image-frame cropping is not a failure when enough of the target remains clearly visible and judgeable. However, cropping becomes a hard visibility failure under the target-visibility gate when almost the entire target lies outside the frame or only a tiny unjudgeable fragment remains. Similarly, foreground target parts may legitimately cover the bed, floor, support surface, or other background content. - Calibration example: dark pillows or other soft furnishings close to the camera may occupy and be cropped by a lower corner. If their silhouettes, fabric folds, shading, and mutual shadows remain coherent, this is valid rendering and must not receive 0 or 1 merely for being dark. It should normally receive 4; use 5 only if the entire image also satisfies the exceptional score-5 gate below. - The image_realism reason must explicitly report both the target-visibility gate and the target-integrity gate. State whether the target is clearly visible and judgeable in with. If visibility fails, describe what little remains visible and assign 0 or 1. If integrity fails, name the damaged/missing target part or abnormal black region, compare it with removed_only or a specific object view, and state the applied score cap. If both pass, explicitly state that a meaningful target portion is visible and its geometry and materials are coherent. Also state whether the large-black/low-light cap, unintended-solid-color cap, flat-gray gate, or any other general hard failure applies. Do not describe normal dark materials, shadows, foreground coverage, moderate frame cropping, reasonable support contact, attachment, or slight support embedding as corruption or penetration. - Score 5 is exceptional and must be rare. Award 5 only when the target is clearly visible and fully coherent, placement and contact are physically plausible, geometry/normals/materials/textures are clean, lighting and shadows are consistent, and no visible artifact, suspicious blank area, penetration, corruption, or meaningful quality concern remains anywhere in Image 1. Passing the hard-failure gates alone is not enough for 5. Use 4 for a strong, fully usable image with any minor imperfection, uncertainty, small artifact, slightly awkward integration, or merely ordinary rendering quality. When uncertain between 4 and 5, always choose 4. 3. Classify object_properties: - relative_scale: exactly one of "XS", "S", "M", "L", or "XL". Judge the complete removed object group’s physical scale relative to the visible scene and nearby objects in Images 1-2. Never use its enlarged crop size in removed_only or the three views. - XS: an object component or sub-part rather than a normally complete standalone object, such as a handle, knob, bulb, small panel, fixture part, or one component of a larger assembly. - S: a small standalone or handheld/tabletop object, such as a cup, book, small ornament, small lamp, or compact container. - M: a normal standalone scene object larger than typical tabletop items but clearly below major furniture scale, such as a floor lamp, medium plant, stool, waste bin, or small appliance. - L: a large object at furniture or major appliance scale, such as a chair, table, sofa, bed, refrigerator, or substantial cabinet. - XL: an architectural or near-architectural-scale object occupying a broad scene region, such as a long wall-spanning curtain, a large built-in wardrobe/cabinet wall, a room divider, or another object comparable to a wall opening or building element. Choose the closest scale class from visible scene evidence. Semantic identity is only an anchor; prioritize the object’s actual scale in this scene. - mechanical_type: exactly "rigid" or "non_rigid". Use "non_rigid" for cloth, curtains, soft furnishings, flexible sheets, deformable vegetation, cables, and similar objects whose shape can deform. Use "rigid" for objects whose shape is normally fixed. Judge the dominant property of a coherent object group. 4. Classify environment_relations using the exact types and levels below. Boolean fields: - has_occlusion: true only when the target is meaningfully partially hidden by foreground scene geometry or participates in a nontrivial layered occlusion boundary. Use removed_only as the primary reference: compare the target silhouette and visible parts in with against the isolated target in removed_only, which represents the same target without scene occluders. If a part is visible in removed_only but disappears or is cut off in with exactly where foreground scene geometry passes in front of it, that is strong evidence of occlusion. Use the front/right/top views as additional references for the target complete structure when needed. Do not classify image-frame cropping, an incomplete removed object, self-occlusion, shadows, or ordinary coverage of the background by a fully visible target as scene occlusion. The reason must identify the foreground occluder and which target part it hides, and should mention the removed_only comparison when it provides the evidence. - has_strong_perspective_depth: true when the scene has strong depth perspective around the target, such as large near-far scale variation, deep spatial placement, or substantial perspective deformation that makes insertion geometry harder. A normal perspective camera alone is not enough. - has_reflective_surface_interaction: this field is specifically about the inserted target changing the appearance of a pre-existing reflective or transmissive scene surface. Use Image 7 only to locate scene regions changed by inserting the target, then inspect the same coordinates in the original with and without images. Image 7 colors mean: blue = the scene became darker, red = the scene became brighter, green = the scene mainly changed color. The color itself does not determine the label. Return true only when all of the following are satisfied: (1) the changed region is outside the inserted target; (2) the receiving scene surface is visibly identifiable as glossy, polished, metallic, glass, water, or another genuinely reflective/refractive material; (3) the aligned with/without comparison shows a clear target-caused change on that surface; (4) the change has reflection, specular-highlight, or refraction characteristics rather than ordinary diffuse illumination; and (5) the change is readily visible to a human at normal viewing scale. Examples that may qualify include the target or its color appearing in a glossy cabinet or polished floor, a target-caused specular highlight changing on metal or glass, or visible refraction through a transmissive scene surface. Return false for ordinary diffuse brightening or darkening of walls, ceilings, fabric, matte wood, or other non-reflective surfaces; generic bounce light or color bleeding; illumination cast by an emissive target; target cast/contact shadows; ordinary light blocking; ambient occlusion; and any vague change for which the receiving surface cannot be confidently identified as reflective or transmissive. A recognizable mirror reflection belongs exclusively to has_mirror_reflection_interaction and must be false here. Material identity alone is not enough: the reflective/refractive content or highlight on that surface must visibly change between with and without. Conversely, a changed region alone is not enough: do not infer reflection merely from red, green, or blue pixels in Image 7. Image 7 is amplified and is never sufficient evidence by itself. When the material, cause, or human visibility is uncertain, return false. The reason must name the receiving scene surface and its visible reflective/transmissive material cue, identify the changed reflection/highlight/refraction, state whether Image 7 shows blue/red/green there, and confirm that the change remains readily visible in the original with/without images. For false, explicitly state which required condition is missing, such as no identifiable reflective receiver, only diffuse illumination, only shadow/light blocking, only a mirror reflection, or insufficient human-visible change. - has_mirror_reflection_interaction: true only when one of the following two evidence paths is satisfied: A. Scene-mirror change: a mirror or mirror-like scene surface contains recognizable reflected content that changes because of the target insertion. Compare the same mirror region at aligned coordinates in with and without. The reflected target, or another recognizable reflected scene object/structure whose mirror image is altered or occluded by the target, must appear, disappear, move, or visibly change between the two images. A mirror merely being present is false. An unchanged mirror image is false, even if it contains many recognizable scene objects. B. Target-is-mirror: the inserted target itself is a mirror or contains a genuine mirror surface, and in with that target mirror visibly reflects recognizable objects or spatial structure from the surrounding environment. Use removed_only and the three views to confirm that the reflective surface belongs to the target, then identify the specific reflected environment content visible after insertion. This path does not require a with/without comparison inside the target region because the target mirror is absent in without. Mandatory decision procedure: first determine whether the candidate mirror belongs to the pre-existing scene or to the inserted target. For a pre-existing scene mirror, true requires a concrete aligned with/without change in its recognizable reflected content caused by the target. For a target mirror, true requires recognizable environment content inside the target mirror. Otherwise return false. Do not use this field for ordinary glossy highlights, reflected color, illumination changes, vague silhouettes, blurry metallic reflections, dark screens, glass without recognizable reflected content, or changes outside the mirror region. Those may belong to has_reflective_surface_interaction but are not mirror interaction. The reason must name the mirror owner, the reflected object or structure, and either the exact with/without mirror-content change for path A or the recognizable environment content reflected by the target mirror for path B. - has_emissive_large_scale_lighting_change: true only when the target is self-emissive and its presence causes a visible large-scale illumination or color change in the surrounding environment. A glowing pixel or bright lamp surface without substantial environmental lighting change is false. Three-level integer fields (must be JSON integers 0, 1, or 2, not booleans): - has_mechanical_interaction: - 0 (none): no clearly visible support, contact, suspension, attachment, or other meaningful force relation with scene geometry can be identified. - 1 (simple): ordinary static support and gravity balance through one simple support arrangement, such as an object resting on a table, shelf, floor, or a single regular base. A target simply mounted on or placed against a wall also counts as simple when no explicit load-bearing suspension mechanism or positional constraint is visible; an object that could plausibly occupy an arbitrary wall position must not be promoted to level 2 merely because it is described as hanging. Several feet touching the same flat floor still normally count as simple unless they create a genuinely nontrivial balance. - 2 (complex): nontrivial force balance involving multiple independent support/contact points or constraints from different directions, tension, clamping, leaning with multiple force-bearing contacts, or another mechanically coupled arrangement whose stability depends on more than ordinary single-surface support. A hanging or suspended target qualifies as level 2 only when the images show an explicit suspension dependency and load path, such as a visible hook, rope, cable, chain, bracket, slot, ceiling attachment, or multiple suspension points that constrain and support the target. Do not infer complex suspension from semantic identity or wall placement alone. Mere proximity without visible force-bearing contact is 0. Assign level 2 only from visible mechanical evidence, not from an assumption about how the object is normally installed. State the visible support/contact points, suspension mechanism, and force relation in the reason. - has_complex_lighting_shadows: - 0 (none): no clearly identifiable target-related shadow is visible; extremely weak generic ambient occlusion that cannot be confidently attributed to the target also counts as 0. - 1 (simple): exactly one dominant target-related contact/cast shadow direction or one coherent shadow lobe is visible under otherwise simple lighting. A soft shadow still counts, but level 1 is allowed only after checking all sides of the target and finding no second independently directed target shadow. - 2 (complex): assign level 2 whenever two or more distinct target-related cast-shadow lobes or projections are visible in different directions, on opposite sides of the target, or on different receiving surfaces. This is direct evidence of multiple or spatially varied light contributions. The shadows may be soft, faint, partially overlapping, or unequal in strength; they do not need to be crisp, high-contrast, intricate, or produced by obvious visible lamps. Also use level 2 for split illumination across the target, multiple light directions, overlapping shadows, strongly spatially varying light, or intricate/high-contrast shadow patterns. Mandatory shadow inspection procedure: 1. Locate the complete target using with and removed_only, then inspect the floor/support and the full perimeter on its left, right, front, and back image sides rather than stopping at the strongest shadow. 2. Compare the same coordinates in with and without. A dark or shaded lobe that appears with the target and disappears or weakens without it is target-related evidence. Use Image 7 to locate subtle non-target changes, then verify them in with/without. 3. Inspect shadows cast by nearby scene objects as supporting evidence for the scene light directions. If those shadows reveal illumination from multiple directions, actively search for the corresponding weaker target projections; scene-object shadows are clues, but level 2 still requires visible target-related shadow or split-light evidence. 4. If two target shadows extend to the left and right, or otherwise diverge in direction, classify level 2 even when one is much softer or less visible than the other. A common level-2 case is one strong lobe on one side plus one broad faint lobe on the opposite side. Do not merge them into one soft shadow and do not reject the weaker lobe merely because its boundary is diffuse. 5. Distinguish ambient occlusion from a weak cast shadow spatially. Ambient occlusion is restricted to a narrow contact rim or crevice that tightly hugs the target base with no directional outward extent. A dark region that spreads outward from the silhouette over the receiving surface, has a displaced or directional lobe shape, or occupies a broader area than the immediate contact rim is a shadow projection, even if it is faint and soft. 6. Use scene lighting evidence as a tie-breaker. When nearby objects show shadows or highlights consistent with two light directions, and the target has one strong lobe plus a weaker outward-spreading lobe in the corresponding second direction, count both target lobes and assign level 2. Do not call the weaker lobe ambient occlusion unless it is strictly confined to the narrow target-contact boundary. Calibration example: a round chair on a rug with a visible projection to its right and a weaker but spatially extended projection to its left is level 2, not level 1. Softness and unequal intensity do not reduce the number of shadow directions. Do not count truly generic ambient occlusion or texture darkening as an additional cast shadow. The reason must enumerate every detected target shadow by image-relative direction and receiving surface. A level-1 reason must explicitly state that every other dark region is confined to a narrow contact rim with no outward directional extent; saying only that it is faint or soft is not sufficient to reject it. [Output requirements] Return only one JSON object wrapped in a json code fence. Use exactly the English keys shown below. Every classification and every relation must have a concise, evidence-based reason. Keep every reason to exactly one sentence of at most 20 English words. Keep the complete response below 700 English words; do not add commentary outside the JSON. { "insertion_description": "insert a table lamp on the side table", "image_realism": 4, "object_properties": { "relative_scale": "S", "mechanical_type": "rigid" }, "environment_relations": { "has_occlusion": false, "has_strong_perspective_depth": false, "has_mechanical_interaction": 1, "has_complex_lighting_shadows": 1, "has_reflective_surface_interaction": false, "has_mirror_reflection_interaction": false, "has_emissive_large_scale_lighting_change": true }, "reason": { "image_realism": "The scene is coherent and has no severe rendering defects.", "relative_scale": "The lamp is a small tabletop object relative to the room and nearby furniture.", "mechanical_type": "The lamp has a fixed rigid body.", "environment_relations": { "has_occlusion": "The complete lamp is visible without meaningful foreground occlusion.", "has_strong_perspective_depth": "The lamp is viewed in a locally shallow region without strong near-far deformation.", "has_mechanical_interaction": "Level 1: the lamp has a simple single-surface support relation with the tabletop.", "has_complex_lighting_shadows": "Level 1: one straightforward cast shadow from the lamp is visible on the tabletop.", "has_reflective_surface_interaction": "No nearby reflective surface visibly changes because of the lamp.", "has_mirror_reflection_interaction": "The lamp is not visibly reflected by a scene mirror and does not itself contain a mirror reflecting recognizable scene objects.", "has_emissive_large_scale_lighting_change": "The lamp visibly changes illumination over a broad surrounding region." } } }
blocks.zh: 提示 S2: 交互分类——完整请求文本 您是三维对象插入数据的高级分析师 。 你会收到七张描述一个插件的图像。 分类插入的对象及其与场景的相互作用。 同时保留图像现实主义质量分数. [输入图像] - 图像1:与,包含目标对象的场景. - 图像2:没有,在移除目标对象后相同的场景. - 图像 3: 仅删除 _ 只删除, 完整删除对象组的孤立渲染 。 - 图像4:完全删除对象组的前视图。 - 图5:完全删除对象组的正确视图。 - 图6:完全删除对象组的顶部视图。 - 图像 7: 隐藏目标对象自身像素后签名的环境差异图 。 黑色表示很少或没有检测到的变化. 蓝色表示之前存在的场景在插入后变得更加暗淡,红色表示它变得更亮,绿色则表示以色调变化为主,鲜有亮度变化. 强度代表了放大的变化幅度。 仅用于定位和输入候选更改,然后在图像1-2中验证其物理意义. 使用图像 3-6 来识别内在对象属性 。 比较图像 1 和 2 以识别对象与环境的关系 。 不要仅仅因为理论上可能就推断出一种关系。 对于布尔字段,只用可见的证据标记真实性. 对于0/1/2字段,只选择有明显证据支持的正值. [任务] 1. 以"在[位置]插入[对象]"的形式写入_说明. 2.分数影像_现实主义从0到5,其中5是最佳. 插入的目标必须在图像1(与)中正确显示。 请检查access-date=中的日期值 (帮助) 图像1和2对渲染崩溃,断裂或缺失几何,错误的常态,严重穿透,异常暴露,纹理缺失,真实未渲染区域,异常的黑色目标部分,以及明显不正确的材料渲染. 僵化但内部一致的场景是可以接受的. - 判官渲染和几何质量,只用于确定插入样品是否可视化。 不要仅仅因为场景是结构化的,抽象的,最小的,异乎寻常的,或者以与插入无关的方式在物理上不可信而降低图像_现实主义. - 可接受上下文包括最小抽象几何、简单的3D渲染风格、已经存在的不相关的漂浮物体,不相关的物理非自然场景内容,以及目标/插入区域外小型孤立的黑色渲染文物,但不影响插入质量或解释。 - 接受目标与预定支持之间的合理接触、支持、附着和轻微嵌入,如在滑行器或附在垫/底物上的杯子。 不要调用普通负载接触, 紧密附件, 或浅支持嵌入严重网状插入 。 只有在几何学明显地通过另一表面时,才能对渗透行为进行处罚,其数量难以想象,造成面部断裂/间断,或对目标造成物质损害或支持斜线。 - 质量问题包括:严重可见网状渗透、断裂或缺失几何、面部异常、黑/亮面不正常、材料渲染明显不正确、暴露或照明异常、黑色/空白无色区域大、无意识的固体色背景大、部分或完全渲染崩溃。 - 大黑/低光分数封盖:如果图像1包含一个大而真实的未交接的黑/空区域,或者场景照明度很低,以至于目标或关键场景结构难以识别,图像_现实主义必须是0,1或2,并且永远不会更高. 当样本尽管存在缺陷但仍可用时使用2;当空白区域或黑暗占据主导,隐藏目标,或阻止可靠解释时使用0或1. 这个上限涉及缺少内容或无法使用的能见度,而不是物理上可信的黑色材料或阴影. - 任何色帽图像的大型意外固体-颜色背景- 现实主义, 当它们明显取代预期的场景内容或显示渲染失败时。 使用更严格的平板格栅门下方 当失败的区域是一个相当大的近单一的中性灰色区域。 - 强制性目标集成门:首先确定目标的全部预期结构、部件、硅胶和从除去的材料_只和前方/右/上方视图。 然后检查每个明显的目标区域 目标必须作为一个成形物体出现:预期的可见部分必须存在,表面必须是连续的,几何特征不能看起来破碎,撕裂,抹去,空心或意外剪断,材料/纹理不能被异常的无特征的黑色补丁所取代. 不授予5,除非这个目标整合检查明确通过。 - 强制性目标可见门:与仅删除的_进行比较,并确定插入的目标中是否有有意义、可识别的部分在场景图像中实际可见。 如果目标几乎是隐形的,因为它几乎完全在框架之外,被场景几何所隐藏,被缩小成只有细小的碎片或分散的碎片,极端的暴露不足,或者与背景融合得非常强烈,以至于无法判断其硅和材料,那么图像_现实主义必须是0或1,永远不是2或更高. 当目标实际上不存在或无法可靠地定位时使用 0;当只有微小的碎片或极弱的痕量残留时使用 1。 作为实际的提示,能见度大约低于预期目标的10%,或者缺少任何连贯可识别的目标部分,通常会触发这一规则。 一个体积小的XS/S对象在仍然清晰的解析和识别时不是失败. - 目标缺陷分数封盖:一个清晰但局部化的目标渲染缺陷,如表面断裂,小部分缺失,孤立的无效黑补丁,错误的正常补丁,纹理缺失,或明显的意外交叉,封盖图像_现实主义在2点. 广泛缺陷,主要目标部分缺失,几何学严重崩溃,或者黑/腐区域在物质上阻碍识别或判断被插入的目标需要图像_现实主义0或1. 一种可见但比较温和的可疑文物,没有明显打破几何或材料将得分封在3. - 对于目标缺陷,一个直接与去除的_只或三个对象视图相矛盾,就是充分的证据;不需要两个独立的指标. 例如,预期目标表面变成一个无特征的黑洞,目标部分突然消失,没有前缘隐蔽器,或物质区域被黑像素所取代,其边界跨越目标本身的几何形状。 这一针对特定目标的规则优先于下文的一般黑/灰色区域规则。 - 硬性平板-灰色未交区门:如果图像1包含一个视质的、几乎一致的中性灰色区域,明显是空的/未交的,而不是场景几何,则图像_现实主义必须是0或1,绝不是2或更高。 决定性证据是一个纯色的灰色区域,几乎没有纹理,材料细节,几何,阴影梯度,照明变异,或物理上有意义的结构,往往以人工边界结束,或取代一个应当存在场景内容的区域. 即使灰色区域不与目标重叠,并且优先于下面的一般非目标双指标规则,这个门也适用. 当空白灰色区域占主导地位或使图像无法使用时使用 0;否则使用 1. 不将平板玻璃门与插入物体或场景照明造成的黑暗混淆。 铸造/接触阴影,阴影壁,灰色材料,雾,或暴露不足的表面,当保存场景纹理,几何,逐渐发光或穿透,物质变异,反射,或与物理物体一致的边界时,仍然有效. 黑暗地区不仅仅是因为面积大或低毗连而不屈服的地区。 - 深色像素、大面积的黑色/灰色区域、低曝光度或与图像边界的接触本身并不产生故障。 在降低分数之前,首先确定该区使用何种几何图形,只删除_,以及三个对象视图。 暗目标材料 暗景物体 织物折叠 物理上可行的铸造/接触阴影 自然暗室 镜头附近的前景物体 普通的图像框裁剪是有效的成像内容. - 有效渲染的证据包括一个连贯的物体形状、连续几何、材料纹理、织物细节或折叠、柔软的阴影梯度、可能的阴影过渡、亮点和遵循可见场景几何的边界。 一个带有任何这些提示的黑暗区域不能仅仅因为其平均亮度低而被称为平坦的,空白的,或者没有降级的. - 普通非目标硬故障规则:只有当有正面的视觉证据表明渲染内容实际上缺失或损坏,并且从实质上阻止对目标的判断时,才能为黑色/灰色/空白场景区域指定图像_现实主义 0或1. 对于非目标/背景地区,至少需要其中两项指标:(a) 该地区真正没有地貌特征,没有几何、纹理、阴影梯度或可能存在的阴影结构;(b) 它有一个突发的边界,不会跟随任何物体的淤塞、遮蔽器、图像框或物理阴影;(c) 它截断或替换只删除的目标部分,或三种视图显示应可见的目标部分;(d) 它与相应的场景几何不相符合;(e) 它产生不可能的孔、抹去的表面或断裂的地形。 这一双指标要求不适用于目标集成门下直接核实的目标缺陷. 只有在明显一致的目标材料或阴影下,而不是仅仅因为与目标位置重叠,才有效。 - 如果目标仍然足够明显和可以判断,图像框架的裁剪并非失败。 然而,在目标可见度门下,几乎整个目标都位于框架之外,或者只有很小的无法判断的碎片留下,作物就成为难以辨识的故障。 同样,前景目标部分可以合法地覆盖床、地板、支撑面或其他背景内容。 - 校准实例:暗枕或其他靠近照相机的软家具可能占据下角并被收割。 如果它们的圆形、织物折叠、阴影和相互的阴影保持连贯,这是有效的渲染,决不能仅仅因为黑暗而得到0或1。 它通常应该得到4;只有当整个图像也满足下面的异常分数-5门时才使用5. - 图像_现实主义理由必须明确报告目标可见门和目标集成门。 说明目标是否清晰可见,是否可与之判断。 如果能见度失败,请描述所剩不多的能见度,并指定0或1. 如果完整性失败, 请指定损坏/ 丢失的目标部分或异常的黑色区域, 将其与已删除的_ 只或特定对象视图相比较, 并声明应用的分数上限 。 如果两者都通过,明确声明一个有意义的目标部分是可见的,其几何和材料是连贯的. 另说明大黑/低光盖,意料之外的固色盖,平板格门,或任何其他一般硬故障是否适用. 不要将正常的暗材料,阴影,前景覆盖,中度框架裁剪,合理支持接触,附件,或轻微支持嵌入为腐败或渗透. - 得分5是特别的 一定罕见 只有目标清晰可见且完全一致时,才给予5号奖,位置和接触在物理上是可信的,几何/常态/材料/纹理是干净的,照明和阴影是一致的,在图像1的任何地方都没有任何可见文物,可疑的空白区域,渗透,腐败或有意义的质量关注. 单通过硬失败的城门不足以维持5年. 使用 4 来显示一个强壮的,完全可用的图像,任何小的不完善,不确定,小的文物,略为尴尬的整合,或者只是普通的渲染质量. 当4到5之间不确定时,总是选择 4个 3. 物品的分类: - 相对_尺度:确切的"XS","S","M","L"或"XL"之一. 判断完整的被移除对象组相对于图像1-2中可见场景和附近物体的物理尺度. 永远不要只用去除的大小或三种视图。 - XS:一个物体组件或子部件,而不是通常完全独立的物体,如手柄、把手、灯泡、小面板、固定部件,或更大的组件的一个部件。 - S:一个小型独立或手持/桌面物体,如杯子、书、小装饰品、小灯或紧凑的容器。 - M:一个普通的独立场景物体,比典型的桌面物品大,但明显低于主要家具尺度,如地板灯、中型厂房、凳子、垃圾桶或小型电器。 - L:家具或主要电器尺寸的大物品,如椅子、桌子、沙发、床、冰箱或大柜。 - XL:占据大面积景区的建筑或近建筑规模的物体,如长墙宽幕、大型内置衣橱/内阁墙、房间分隔器,或与墙面开口或建筑元素相当的另一物体。 从可见的场景证据中选择最接近的尺度类 。 语义特征只是锚;在此场景中优先排列对象的实际尺度. - 机械型:完全"刚性"或"非刚性". 使用"non_rigid"来表示布,窗帘,软家具,柔性床单,变形植被,电缆,以及形状可以变形的类似物体. 对形状通常固定的物体使用"rigid". 判断一致对象组的主导财产. 4. 使用以下确切类型和水平对环境关系进行分类。 布尔字段 : - has_oclusion:只有当目标被前地场景几何学有意义地部分隐藏或参与非三角层的oclusion边界时才属实. 仅使用已删除的_仅作为主参考: 将目标 silhouette 和可见部分与在已删除的_仅中孤立的目标进行比较,它代表了没有场景占用器的同一目标. 如果某一部分在除去的_只可见,但消失或被切断,并精确地与前方场景几何经过其前方的地方,这就是隔离的有力证据. 必要时使用前/右/上视图作为目标完整结构的额外参考. 不要将图像框架裁剪,不完全删除的物体,自我隐蔽,阴影,或被完全可见的目标普通覆盖的背景归类为场景隐蔽. 理由必须确定前方占地者和它隐藏的目标部分,并应在提供证据时提及去除的_只比较。 - has_strong_perspective_深入:当场景在目标周围有强烈的深度视角时是真实的,如大型的近距离尺度变异,深空定位,或实质性的视角变形使得插入几何更难. 光是普通的镜头是不够的 - 具有_ reflective_表面_interact:此字段具体指插入的目标改变先前存在的反射或传动场景表面的外观. 使用图像 7 只通过插入目标来定位更改的场景区域, 然后检查原始坐标中是否有图像。 图片7颜色表示:蓝色=场景变暗,红色=场景变亮,绿色=场景主要变色. 颜色本身并不决定标签。 只有当满足以下所有条件时,才能返回真实:(1) 改变的区域在插入的目标之外;(2) 接收场景表面可明显识别为光泽、抛光、金属、玻璃、水或其他真正反射/反射材料;(3) 与/不作比较,显示该表面有明显的目标导致的变化;(4) 变化具有反射、光谱高度或折射特性,而不是普通的散射;(5) 变化在正常视野范围内对人来说很容易看到。 可能符合条件的例子包括:目标或其颜色出现在光滑的柜子或抛光的地板上,目标导致的光谱亮度在金属或玻璃上变化,或通过传导场景表面可见折射. 对壁、天花板、布料、垫木或其他非反光表面进行普通散射亮度或变暗的光度、一般弹光或彩色出血、发射目标投射光度、目标投影/接触阴影、普通光阻、环境掩蔽、以及接收表面不能被确定为反射或传导的任何模糊变化。 一个可识别的镜像反射只属于 has_mirror_reflection_interactive, 并且必须在这里作假. 仅凭物质特性是不够的:反射/反射内容或表面的突出点必须随与不发生明显变化。 反之,仅仅改变区域是不够的:不要仅仅从图像中的红色、绿色或蓝色像素推断反射 7个 图像7被放大,从来就不是充分的证据。 当材料,原因,或人类的能见度不确定时,返回虚假. 原因必须指定接收场景表面及其可见的反射/传播材料提示,识别已改变的反射/亮度/折射,说明图像7是否显示蓝色/红色/绿色,并证实该变化在原图中与/无图像仍然很容易看到. 对于虚假的,明确要求条件的状态是缺失的,如没有可识别的反射接收器,只有散射,只有阴影/光阻,只有镜面反射,或者人视变化不足. - has_mirror_reflection_interact:只有在满足以下两个证据路径之一时才为真 : A. 场景-镜像变化:镜像或镜像场景表面包含可识别的反射内容,由于目标插入而改变. 在对齐的坐标上和不对齐的坐标上比较同一个镜面区域. 反射目标,或者另一个可识别的反射场景物体/结构,其镜像被目标改变或占据,必须在两个图像之间出现,消失,移动,或明显改变. 光是一面镜子就是假的。 一个不变的镜像是虚假的,即使它包含许多可识别的场景对象. B. 目标 -- -- 模拟:插入的目标本身是一个镜子或包含一个真实的镜子表面,与目标镜子一起明显地反映周围环境中可辨认的物体或空间结构。 仅使用移除的_和三种视图确认反射面属于目标,然后识别插入后可见的特定反射环境内容. 这一路径不需要与目标区域内的/不作比较,因为目标镜不存在。 强制决定程序:首先确定候选镜是否属于原有场景或插入的目标. 对于先前存在的场景镜来说,真面目需要与目标造成的可识别的反射内容一致/不加改变的混凝土. 对于目标镜来说,真实性要求目标镜内部可识别的环境内容. 否则假归. 不要将这个字段用于普通的光泽亮度,反射的颜色,光线的变化,模糊的光线,模糊的金属反射,暗幕,没有可识别的反射内容的玻璃,或者镜面区域以外的变化. 这些可能属于“反射”-表面_交互,但不是镜像交互。 原因必须指定镜像所有者,被映射的对象或结构,以及路径 A 的精确/不包含镜像内容变化,或者路径 B 的目标镜所反映的可识别的环境内容. – has_immissive_group_scale_lighting_change: 只有在目标为自失能且其存在导致周围环境发生明显大规模照明或颜色变化时才属真. 发光像素或明亮的灯光表面没有重大的环境照明变化是虚假的. 三级整数字段( 必须是 JSON 整数 0, 1 或 2, 而不是布尔 ) : - 具有_机械_交互: - 0(无):无法识别与场景几何相关的明显可见的支持,接触,悬浮,附加,或其他有意义的力关系. - 1(简单):普通静态支持和重力平衡,通过一个简单的支持安排,例如一个物体在桌子,架子,地板上休息,或者一个单一的固定基座. 仅仅挂在墙上或放在墙上的目标,在没有明显的负载悬浮机制或位置约束的情况下,也算作简单;一个可以合理占据任意墙位的物体,不能仅仅因为被描述为悬挂而晋升到二级。 接触同一平地的几英尺通常仍算得简单,除非它们能形成真正的非三角平衡。 - 2(复杂):非三角力平衡,涉及来自不同方向的多个独立支持/接触点或制约、紧张、夹住、倾斜多种强力接触,或另一种机械偶联安排,其稳定性取决于超出普通单表面支持。 悬挂或悬浮目标只有在图像显示明显的悬浮依赖和负载路径,如可见的钩子,绳索,电缆,链条,括号,插槽,天花板附件,或限制和支持目标的多个悬浮点时,才符合第二级条件. 不得从语义特征或墙壁放置中推断复杂的悬浮。 没有可见力接触的近距离为0. 只从可见的机械证据来指定第二级,而不是从对物体通常如何安装的假设来指定. 说明可见的支持/接触点、暂停机制以及武力关系。 - has_complex_lighting_shadows: -0(无):没有明显可识别的目标相关阴影可见;极弱的无法自信地归属于目标的一般环境掩蔽也算为0.1(简单):在否则简单的照明下,完全可见一个主目标相关接触/播影方向或一个连贯的阴影叶. 柔软的阴影仍然算数,但1级只有在检查目标方方面面,发现没有第二位独立定向的目标阴影后才允许. - 2(复杂):当两个或两个以上不同的目标相关铸影叶或预测在不同方向、目标对面或不同接收面可见时,指定二级。 这是多种或空间差异的光作用的直接证据。 阴影可能是软的,微弱的,部分重叠的,或者强度不平等的;它们不需要脆脆的,高的,复杂的,或者由明显的可见灯光产生. 也使用二级来进行横跨目标的分光,多光方向,重叠的阴影,强烈的空间差异的光,或复杂/高孔的阴影模式. 强制性影子检查程序: 1. 确定仅使用并拆除的完整目标,然后检查其左、右、前、后图像侧的地板/支持和整个周边,而不是最强的阴影。 2. 将同样的坐标与非坐标进行比较。 与目标一起出现并消失或削弱的暗色或遮蔽叶片是目标相关证据. 使用图像 7 来定位微妙的非目标更改, 然后用/ 不使用这些更改来验证 。 3. 附近场景物体所投下的检查阴影,作为场景灯光方向的支持证据. 如果这些阴影从多个方向显示出照明,则积极搜索相应的较弱的目标预测;场景-对象阴影是线索,但第2级仍然需要与目标相关的明显阴影或分光证据. 4. 如果两个目标阴影延伸至左侧和右侧,或者在方向上出现差异,即使一个比另一个更柔软或更不明显,仍将二级分类。 常见的2级病例是一侧的强叶加上另一侧的宽弱叶. 不要把它们合并成一个柔软的阴影,不要仅仅因为弱叶的边界分散而拒绝它。 5. 在空间空间上区分环境隔离和薄弱的阴影。 环境隔离被限制在狭长的接触圈或裂缝上,紧紧地拥抱目标基地,没有方向外径. 黑暗区域从光圈向外扩散到接收的表面,具有偏移或方向叶形,或占据比直接接触线圈更宽的区域是阴影投影,即使它微弱柔软. 6. 利用场景照明证据作为打结工具。 当附近的物体显示与两个光线方向一致的阴影或亮度,而目标有一个坚固的叶片加上相应的第二个方向的较弱的向外扩张的叶片时,计算两个目标叶片并分配级别. 2. 国家 不要称弱叶环境闭塞,除非它严格限于狭小的目标接触边界. 校准实例:地毯上的圆椅,右侧有可见投影,左侧有较弱但空间延伸的投影是第二级,而非第二级 一、导 言 柔和和不平等的强度并不能减少阴影方向的数量. 不要把真正通用的环境遮蔽或纹理变暗算作额外的阴影。 理由必须按图像相对方向和接收表面列出每个被探测到的目标阴影。 一级理由必须明确指出,所有其他黑暗区域都局限于一个狭窄的接触圈,没有外向方向;只说它微弱或柔软不足以拒绝它。 [产出要求] 只归还一个JSON物体 包裹在Json密码栅栏里 精确使用下面显示的英文密钥 。 每一种分类和每一种关系都必须有一个简明、基于证据的理由。 将所有理由保留在最多20个英文单词的一个句子上。 将完整响应保留在700个英文单词以下;不要在JSON之外添加评论. {"插入_描述":"在副台上插入一张桌子灯","图像_现实主义":4,"对象_财产":{"相对_尺度":"S","机械_类型":"刚性","环境_关系",{"已经_包容"虚假","强性_投机_深度","已经_机器_交互":1,"已经_复杂_灯光_阴影":1,"已经_反射_表面_交互":虚假,"哈斯_讽刺_反射_规模_光亮_变化":假,"已经_正性","理性":{现实主义": "剧情连贯,没有严重的渲染缺陷","相对_尺度": "灯是相对于房间和附近家具的一个小台顶物体","机械型":"灯具有固定的刚性体","环境-关系":{"has_oclusion": "完整的灯光是可见的,没有有意义的前景隐蔽","has_strong_perspective_深入": "该灯在局部浅海区域不见强烈近距离变形","has_mectic_interactive": "一级:该灯与台顶有简单的单表面支撑关系","has_complex_lighting_shadows":"一级:该灯一个直截了当的投影在台顶上可见","has_reflective_profect_interact":"由于该灯,没有附近反光表面明显的变化","has_mirror_reflection_interact": "该灯没有被场景镜所明显反映,本身也没有包含反射镜可识别的场景物体","has_emissive_magest_scale_lighting_change": "灯光明显地改变着周围广大地区的光芒。"

blocks.en: You are a senior analyst of 3D object-insertion data. You will receive seven images describing one insertion case. Classify the inserted object and its interactions with the scene. Also retain an image-realism quality score.
blocks.zh: 您是三维对象插入数据的高级分析师 。 你会收到七张描述一个插件的图像。 分类插入的对象及其与场景的相互作用。 同时保留图像现实主义质量分数.

blocks.en: [Input images]
blocks.zh: [输入图像]

blocks.en: - Image 1: with, the scene containing the target object.
blocks.zh: - 图片1:与,包含目标物体的场景。

blocks.en: - Image 2: without, the same scene after removing the target object.
blocks.zh: - 图像2:没有,在移除目标对象后相同的场景.

blocks.en: - Image 3: removed_only, an isolated rendering of the complete removed object group.
blocks.zh: - 图像 3: 仅删除 _ 只删除, 完整删除对象组的孤立渲染 。

blocks.en: - Image 4: front view of the complete removed object group.
blocks.zh: - 图像4:完全删除对象组的前视图。

blocks.en: - Image 5: right view of the complete removed object group.
blocks.zh: - 图5:完全删除对象组的正确视图。

blocks.en: - Image 6: top view of the complete removed object group.
blocks.zh: - 图6:完全删除对象组的顶部视图。

blocks.en: - Image 7: signed environment difference map after masking the target object’s own pixels. Black means little or no detected change. Blue means the pre-existing scene became darker after insertion, red means it became brighter, and green means a mainly chromatic change with little luminance change. Intensity represents amplified change magnitude. Use it only to locate and type candidate changes, then verify their physical meaning in Images 1-2.
blocks.zh: - 图像 7: 隐藏目标对象自身像素后签名的环境差异图 。 黑色表示很少或没有检测到的变化. 蓝色表示之前存在的场景在插入后变得更加暗淡,红色表示它变得更亮,绿色则表示以色调变化为主,鲜有亮度变化. 强度代表了放大的变化幅度。 仅用于定位和输入候选更改,然后在图像1-2中验证其物理意义.

blocks.en: Use Images 3-6 to identify intrinsic object properties. Compare Images 1 and 2 to identify object-environment relations. Do not infer a relation merely because it is theoretically possible. For boolean fields, mark true only with visible evidence. For 0/1/2 fields, choose a positive level only with visible evidence supporting that level.
blocks.zh: 使用图像 3-6 来识别内在对象属性 。 比较图像 1 和 2 以识别对象与环境的关系 。 不要仅仅因为理论上可能就推断出一种关系。 对于布尔字段,只用可见的证据标记真实. 对于0/1/2字段,只选择有明显证据支持的正值.

blocks.en: [Tasks]
blocks.zh: [任务]

blocks.en: 1. Write insertion_description in the form "insert [object] at [location]".
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 在表单中写入插入_描述“在[位置]插入[对象]”。

blocks.en: 2. Score image_realism from 0 to 5, where 5 is best. The inserted target must be correctly rendered in Image 1 (with). Check Images 1 and 2 for rendering collapse, broken or missing geometry, wrong normals, severe penetration, abnormal exposure, missing textures, genuinely unrendered regions, abnormal black target parts, and clearly incorrect material rendering. Stylized but internally consistent scenes are acceptable.
blocks.zh: 2. 国家 分数图像_现实主义从0到5,其中5是最佳. 插入的目标必须在图像1(与)中正确显示。 请检查access-date=中的日期值 (帮助) 图像1和2对渲染崩溃,断裂或缺失几何,错误的常态,严重穿透,异常暴露,纹理缺失,真实未渲染区域,异常的黑色目标部分,以及明显不正确的材料渲染. 僵化但内部一致的场景是可以接受的.

blocks.en: - Judge rendering and geometry quality only to determine whether the insertion sample is visually usable. Do not lower image_realism merely because the scene is stylized, abstract, minimal, semantically unusual, or physically implausible in ways unrelated to the insertion.
blocks.zh: - 判官渲染和几何质量,只用于确定插入样品是否可视化。 不要仅仅因为场景是结构化的,抽象的,最小的,异乎寻常的,或者以与插入无关的方式在物理上不可信而降低图像_现实主义.

blocks.en: - Acceptable context includes minimal abstract geometry, a simple 3D rendering style, unrelated floating objects already present in without, unrelated physically unnatural scene content, and small isolated black rendering artifacts outside the target/insertion region when they do not affect insertion quality or interpretation.
blocks.zh: - 可接受上下文包括最小抽象几何、简单的3D渲染风格、已经存在的不相关的漂浮物体,不相关的物理非自然场景内容,以及目标/插入区域外小型孤立的黑色渲染文物,但不影响插入质量或解释。

blocks.en: - Accept reasonable contact, support, attachment, and slight embedding between the target and its intended support, such as a cup resting on a coaster or an object attached to a pad/base. Do not call ordinary load-bearing contact, a tight attachment, or shallow support embedding severe mesh penetration. Penalize penetration only when geometry visibly passes through another surface by an implausible amount, produces broken/interleaved faces, or materially damages the target or support silhouette.
blocks.zh: - 接受目标与预定支持之间的合理接触、支持、附着和轻微嵌入,如在滑行器或附在垫/底物上的杯子。 不要调用普通负载接触, 紧密附件, 或浅支持嵌入严重网状插入 。 只有在几何学明显地通过另一表面时,才能对渗透行为进行处罚,其数量难以想象,造成面部断裂/间断,或对目标造成物质损害或支持斜线。

blocks.en: - Quality problems include severe visible mesh penetration, broken or missing geometry, abnormal faces, wrong-normal black/bright faces, clearly incorrect material rendering, abnormal exposure or lighting, large black/blank unrendered regions, large unintended solid-color backgrounds, and partial or complete rendering collapse.
blocks.zh: - 质量问题包括:严重可见网状渗透、断裂或缺失几何、面部异常、黑/亮面不正常、材料渲染明显不正确、暴露或照明异常、黑色/空白无色区域大、无意识的固体色背景大、部分或完全渲染崩溃。

blocks.en: - Large-black/low-light score cap: if Image 1 contains a large genuinely unrendered black/blank region, or scene illumination is so low that the target or key scene structure is difficult to recognize, image_realism must be 0, 1, or 2 and never higher. Use 2 when the sample remains usable despite the defect; use 0 or 1 when the blank region or darkness dominates, hides the target, or prevents reliable interpretation. This cap concerns missing content or unusable visibility, not physically plausible black materials or shadows.
blocks.zh: - 大黑/低光分数封盖:如果图像1包含一个大而真实的未交接的黑/空区域,或者场景照明度很低,以至于目标或关键场景结构难以识别,图像_现实主义必须是0,1或2,并且永远不会更高. 当样本尽管存在缺陷但仍可用时使用2;当空白区域或黑暗占据主导,隐藏目标,或阻止可靠解释时使用0或1. 这个上限涉及缺少内容或无法使用的能见度,而不是物理上可信的黑色材料或阴影.

blocks.en: - Large unintended solid-color backgrounds of any color cap image_realism at 2 when they visibly replace expected scene content or indicate rendering failure. Apply the stricter flat-gray gate below when the failed region is a substantial near-uniform neutral gray area.
blocks.zh: - 任何色帽图像的大型意外固体-颜色背景- 现实主义, 当它们明显取代预期的场景内容或显示渲染失败时。 使用更严格的平板格栅门下方 当失败的区域是一个相当大的近单一的中性灰色区域。

blocks.en: - Mandatory target-integrity gate: first identify the target’s complete expected structure, parts, silhouette, and materials from removed_only and the front/right/top views. Then inspect every visible target region in with. The target must appear as a coherent rendered object: expected visible parts must exist, surfaces must be continuous, geometry must not look shattered, torn, erased, hollow, or accidentally clipped, and materials/textures must not be replaced by anomalous featureless black patches. Do not award 5 unless this target-integrity check clearly passes.
blocks.zh: - 强制性目标集成门:首先确定目标的全部预期结构、部件、硅胶和从除去的材料_只和前方/右/上方视图。 然后检查每个明显的目标区域 目标必须作为一个成形物体出现:预期的可见部分必须存在,表面必须是连续的,几何特征不能看起来破碎,撕裂,抹去,空心或意外剪断,材料/纹理不能被异常的无特征的黑色补丁所取代. 不授予5,除非这个目标整合检查明确通过。

blocks.en: - Mandatory target-visibility gate: compare with against removed_only and determine whether a meaningful, recognizable portion of the inserted target is actually visible in the scene image. If the target is almost invisible because it is nearly entirely outside the frame, hidden by scene geometry, reduced to only a tiny sliver or scattered fragments, extremely underexposed, or merged with the background so strongly that its silhouette and material cannot be judged, image_realism must be 0 or 1 and never 2 or higher. Use 0 when the target is effectively absent or cannot be reliably located in with; use 1 when only a tiny insufficient fragment or extremely weak trace remains. As a practical cue, visibility of roughly less than 10 percent of the expected projected target silhouette, or the absence of any coherent identifiable target part, normally triggers this rule. A physically small XS/S object is not a failure when it is still clearly resolved and recognizable.
blocks.zh: - 强制性目标可见门:与仅删除的_进行比较,并确定插入的目标中是否有有意义、可识别的部分在场景图像中实际可见。 如果目标几乎是隐形的,因为它几乎完全在框架之外,被场景几何所隐藏,被缩小成只有细小的碎片或分散的碎片,极端的暴露不足,或者与背景融合得非常强烈,以至于无法判断其硅和材料,那么图像_现实主义必须是0或1,永远不是2或更高. 当目标实际上不存在或无法可靠地定位时使用 0;当只有微小的碎片或极弱的痕量残留时使用 1。 作为实际的提示,能见度大约低于预期目标的10%,或者缺少任何连贯可识别的目标部分,通常会触发这一规则。 一个体积小的XS/S对象在仍然清晰的解析和识别时不是失败.

blocks.en: - Target-defect score caps: a clear but localized target rendering defect, such as a broken surface, missing small part, isolated invalid black patch, wrong-normal patch, texture dropout, or obvious unintended intersection, caps image_realism at 2. A widespread defect, a missing major target part, severe geometry collapse, or a black/corrupt region that materially prevents recognizing or judging the inserted target requires image_realism 0 or 1. A visible but milder suspicious artifact that does not clearly break geometry or materials caps the score at 3.
blocks.zh: - 目标缺陷分数封盖:一个清晰但局部化的目标渲染缺陷,如表面断裂,小部分缺失,孤立的无效黑补丁,错误的正常补丁,纹理缺失,或明显的意外交叉,封盖图像_现实主义在2点. 广泛缺陷,主要目标部分缺失,几何学严重崩溃,或者黑/腐区域在物质上阻碍识别或判断被插入的目标需要图像_现实主义0或1. 一种可见但比较温和的可疑文物,没有明显打破几何或材料封顶3分的分数.

blocks.en: - For target defects, one direct contradiction with removed_only or the three object views is sufficient evidence; do not require two independent indicators. Examples include an expected target surface becoming a featureless black hole, a target part abruptly disappearing without a foreground occluder, or a material region being replaced by black pixels whose boundary cuts across the target’s own geometry. This target-specific rule takes priority over the general black/gray-region rule below.
blocks.zh: - 对于目标缺陷,一个直接与去除的_只或三个对象视图相矛盾就是充分的证据;不需要两个独立的指标. 例如,预期目标表面变成一个无特征的黑洞,目标部分突然消失,没有前缘隐蔽器,或物质区域被黑像素所取代,其边界跨越目标本身的几何形状。 这一针对特定目标的规则优先于下文的一般黑/灰色区域规则。

blocks.en: - Mandatory flat-gray unrendered-region gate: if Image 1 contains a visually substantial region of nearly uniform neutral gray that is clearly empty/unrendered rather than scene geometry, image_realism must be 0 or 1 and never 2 or higher. The decisive evidence is a pure-color-like gray area with almost no texture, material detail, geometry, shading gradient, lighting variation, or physically meaningful structure, often ending at an artificial boundary or replacing an area where scene content should exist. This gate applies even when the gray region does not overlap the target and takes priority over the general non-target two-indicator rule below. Use 0 when the blank gray region dominates or makes the image unusable; otherwise use 1.
blocks.zh: - 硬性平板-灰色未交区门:如果图像1包含一个视质的、几乎一致的中性灰色区域,明显是空的/未交的,而不是场景几何,则图像_现实主义必须是0或1,绝不是2或更高。 决定性证据是一个纯色的灰色区域,几乎没有纹理,材料细节,几何,阴影梯度,照明变异,或物理上有意义的结构,往往以人工边界结束,或取代一个应当存在场景内容的区域. 即使灰色区域不与目标重叠,并且优先于下面的一般非目标双指标规则,这个门也适用. 当空白灰色区域主导或使图像无法使用时使用 0;否则使用 1。

blocks.en: - Do not confuse the flat-gray gate with darkness caused by the inserted object or scene lighting. A cast/contact shadow, shaded wall, gray material, fog, or underexposed surface remains valid when it preserves scene texture, geometry, gradual illumination or penumbra, material variation, reflections, or boundaries consistent with physical objects. A dark region is not a pure-gray unrendered region merely because it is large or low-contrast.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 不要混淆平板玻璃门和被插入物体或场景照明造成的黑暗. 铸造/接触阴影,阴影壁,灰色材料,雾,或暴露不足的表面,当保存场景纹理,几何,逐渐发光或穿透,物质变异,反射,或与物理物体一致的边界时,仍然有效. 黑暗地区不仅仅是因为面积大或低毗连而不屈服的地区。

blocks.en: - Dark pixels, a large black/gray area, low exposure, or contact with the image boundary are not by themselves rendering failures. Before lowering the score, first identify what geometry occupies that region using with, removed_only, and the three object views. Dark target materials, dark scene objects, fabric folds, physically plausible cast/contact shadows, naturally dark rooms, foreground objects close to the camera, and ordinary image-frame cropping are valid rendered content.
blocks.zh: - 深色像素、大面积的黑色/灰色区域、低曝光度或与图像边界的接触本身并不产生故障。 在降低分数之前,首先确定该区使用何种几何图形,只删除_,以及三个对象视图。 暗目标材料 暗景物体 织物折叠 物理上可行的铸造/接触阴影 自然暗室 镜头附近的前景物体 普通的图像框裁剪是有效的成像内容.

blocks.en: - Evidence of valid rendering includes a coherent object silhouette, continuous geometry, material texture, fabric detail or folds, soft shading gradients, plausible shadow transitions, highlights, and boundaries that follow visible scene geometry. A dark region with any of these cues must not be called flat, blank, or unrendered merely because its average brightness is low.
blocks.zh: - 有效渲染的证据包括一个连贯的物体形状、连续几何、材料纹理、织物细节或折叠、柔软的阴影梯度、可能的阴影过渡、亮点和遵循可见场景几何的边界。 一个带有任何这些提示的黑暗区域不能仅仅因为其平均亮度低而被称为平坦的,空白的,或者没有降级的.

blocks.en: - General non-target hard failure rule: assign image_realism 0 or 1 for a black/gray/blank scene region only when there is positive visual evidence that rendering content is actually missing or corrupted and it materially prevents judging the target. For non-target/background regions, require at least two of these indicators: (a) the region is genuinely featureless with no geometry, texture, shading gradient, or plausible shadow structure; (b) it has an abrupt boundary that does not follow any object silhouette, occluder, image frame, or physical shadow; (c) it cuts through or replaces target parts that removed_only or the three views show should be visible; (d) it is inconsistent with the corresponding scene geometry in with/without; (e) it produces impossible holes, erased surfaces, or broken topology. This two-indicator requirement does not apply to a directly verified target defect under the target-integrity gate. A dark region appearing only in with is valid only when it is visibly coherent target material or shading, not merely because it overlaps the target location.
blocks.zh: - 普通非目标硬故障规则:只有当有正面的视觉证据表明渲染内容实际上缺失或损坏,并且从实质上阻止对目标的判断时,才能为黑色/灰色/空白场景区域指定图像_现实主义 0或1. 对于非目标/背景地区,至少需要其中两项指标:(a) 该地区真正没有地貌特征,没有几何、纹理、阴影梯度或可能存在的阴影结构;(b) 它有一个突发的边界,不会跟随任何物体的淤塞、遮蔽器、图像框或物理阴影;(c) 它截断或替换只删除的目标部分,或三种视图显示应可见的目标部分;(d) 它与相应的场景几何不相符合;(e) 它产生不可能的孔、抹去的表面或断裂的地形。 这一双指标要求不适用于目标集成门下直接核实的目标缺陷. 只有在明显一致的目标材料或阴影下,而不是仅仅因为与目标位置重叠,才有效。

blocks.en: - Image-frame cropping is not a failure when enough of the target remains clearly visible and judgeable. However, cropping becomes a hard visibility failure under the target-visibility gate when almost the entire target lies outside the frame or only a tiny unjudgeable fragment remains. Similarly, foreground target parts may legitimately cover the bed, floor, support surface, or other background content.
blocks.zh: - 如果目标仍然足够明显和可以判断,图像框架的裁剪并非失败。 然而,在目标可见度门下,几乎整个目标都位于框架之外,或者只有很小的无法判断的碎片留下,作物就成为难以辨识的故障。 同样,前景目标部分可以合法地覆盖床、地板、支撑面或其他背景内容。

blocks.en: - Calibration example: dark pillows or other soft furnishings close to the camera may occupy and be cropped by a lower corner. If their silhouettes, fabric folds, shading, and mutual shadows remain coherent, this is valid rendering and must not receive 0 or 1 merely for being dark. It should normally receive 4; use 5 only if the entire image also satisfies the exceptional score-5 gate below.
blocks.zh: - 校准实例:暗枕或其他靠近照相机的软家具可能占据下角并被收割。 如果它们的圆形、织物折叠、阴影和相互的阴影保持连贯,这是有效的渲染,决不能仅仅因为黑暗而得到0或1。 它通常应该得到4;只有当整个图像也满足下面的异常分数-5门时才使用5.

blocks.en: - The image_realism reason must explicitly report both the target-visibility gate and the target-integrity gate. State whether the target is clearly visible and judgeable in with. If visibility fails, describe what little remains visible and assign 0 or 1. If integrity fails, name the damaged/missing target part or abnormal black region, compare it with removed_only or a specific object view, and state the applied score cap. If both pass, explicitly state that a meaningful target portion is visible and its geometry and materials are coherent. Also state whether the large-black/low-light cap, unintended-solid-color cap, flat-gray gate, or any other general hard failure applies. Do not describe normal dark materials, shadows, foreground coverage, moderate frame cropping, reasonable support contact, attachment, or slight support embedding as corruption or penetration.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 图像_现实主义理由必须明确报告目标可见门和目标集成门. 说明目标是否清晰可见,是否可与之判断。 如果能见度失败,请描述所剩不多的能见度,并指定0或1. 如果完整性失败, 请指定损坏/ 丢失的目标部分或异常的黑色区域, 将其与已删除的_ 只或特定对象视图相比较, 并声明应用的分数上限 。 如果两者都通过,明确声明一个有意义的目标部分是可见的,其几何和材料是连贯的. 另说明大黑/低光盖,意料之外的固色盖,平板格门,或任何其他一般硬故障是否适用. 不要将正常的暗材料,阴影,前景覆盖,中度框架裁剪,合理支持接触,附件,或轻微支持嵌入为腐败或渗透.

blocks.en: - Score 5 is exceptional and must be rare. Award 5 only when the target is clearly visible and fully coherent, placement and contact are physically plausible, geometry/normals/materials/textures are clean, lighting and shadows are consistent, and no visible artifact, suspicious blank area, penetration, corruption, or meaningful quality concern remains anywhere in Image 1. Passing the hard-failure gates alone is not enough for 5. Use 4 for a strong, fully usable image with any minor imperfection, uncertainty, small artifact, slightly awkward integration, or merely ordinary rendering quality. When uncertain between 4 and 5, always choose 4.
blocks.zh: - 得分5是特别的 一定罕见 只有目标清晰可见且完全一致时,才给予5号奖,位置和接触在物理上是可信的,几何/常态/材料/纹理是干净的,照明和阴影是一致的,在图像1的任何地方都没有任何可见文物,可疑的空白区域,渗透,腐败或有意义的质量关注. 单通过硬失败的城门不足以维持5年. 使用 4 来显示一个强壮的,完全可用的图像,任何小的不完善,不确定,小的文物,略为尴尬的整合,或者只是普通的渲染质量. 当4到5之间不确定时,总是选择4.

blocks.en: 3. Classify object_properties:
blocks.zh: 3个 分类对象(_R):

blocks.en: - relative_scale: exactly one of "XS", "S", "M", "L", or "XL". Judge the complete removed object group’s physical scale relative to the visible scene and nearby objects in Images 1-2. Never use its enlarged crop size in removed_only or the three views.
blocks.zh: - 相对_尺度:确切的"XS","S","M","L"或"XL"之一. 判断完整的被移除对象组相对于图像1-2中可见场景和附近物体的物理尺度. 永远不要只用去除的大小或三种视图。

blocks.en: - XS: an object component or sub-part rather than a normally complete standalone object, such as a handle, knob, bulb, small panel, fixture part, or one component of a larger assembly.
blocks.zh: - XS:一个物体组件或子部件,而不是通常完全独立的物体,如手柄、把手、灯泡、小面板、固定部件,或更大的组件的一个部件。

blocks.en: - S: a small standalone or handheld/tabletop object, such as a cup, book, small ornament, small lamp, or compact container.
blocks.zh: - S:一个小型独立或手持/桌面物体,如杯子、书、小装饰品、小灯或紧凑的容器。

blocks.en: - M: a normal standalone scene object larger than typical tabletop items but clearly below major furniture scale, such as a floor lamp, medium plant, stool, waste bin, or small appliance.
blocks.zh: - M:一个普通的独立场景物体,比典型的桌面物品大,但明显低于主要家具尺度,如地板灯、中型厂房、凳子、垃圾桶或小型电器。

blocks.en: - L: a large object at furniture or major appliance scale, such as a chair, table, sofa, bed, refrigerator, or substantial cabinet.
blocks.zh: - L:家具或主要电器尺寸的大物品,如椅子、桌子、沙发、床、冰箱或大柜。

blocks.en: - XL: an architectural or near-architectural-scale object occupying a broad scene region, such as a long wall-spanning curtain, a large built-in wardrobe/cabinet wall, a room divider, or another object comparable to a wall opening or building element.
blocks.zh: - XL:占据大面积景区的建筑或近建筑规模的物体,如长墙宽幕、大型内置衣橱/内阁墙、房间分隔器,或与墙面开口或建筑元素相当的另一物体。

blocks.en: Choose the closest scale class from visible scene evidence. Semantic identity is only an anchor; prioritize the object’s actual scale in this scene.
blocks.zh: 从可见的场景证据中选择最接近的尺度类 。 语义特征只是锚;在此场景中优先排列对象的实际尺度.

blocks.en: - mechanical_type: exactly "rigid" or "non_rigid". Use "non_rigid" for cloth, curtains, soft furnishings, flexible sheets, deformable vegetation, cables, and similar objects whose shape can deform. Use "rigid" for objects whose shape is normally fixed. Judge the dominant property of a coherent object group.
blocks.zh: - 机械型:完全"刚性"或"非刚性". 使用"non_rigid"来表示布,窗帘,软家具,柔性床单,变形植被,电缆,以及形状可以变形的类似物体. 对形状通常固定的物体使用"rigid". 判断一致对象组的主导财产.

blocks.en: 4. Classify environment_relations using the exact types and levels below.
blocks.zh: 4个 使用下面的准确类型和级别对环境进行分类。

blocks.en: Boolean fields:
blocks.zh: 布尔字段 :

blocks.en: - has_occlusion: true only when the target is meaningfully partially hidden by foreground scene geometry or participates in a nontrivial layered occlusion boundary. Use removed_only as the primary reference: compare the target silhouette and visible parts in with against the isolated target in removed_only, which represents the same target without scene occluders. If a part is visible in removed_only but disappears or is cut off in with exactly where foreground scene geometry passes in front of it, that is strong evidence of occlusion. Use the front/right/top views as additional references for the target complete structure when needed. Do not classify image-frame cropping, an incomplete removed object, self-occlusion, shadows, or ordinary coverage of the background by a fully visible target as scene occlusion. The reason must identify the foreground occluder and which target part it hides, and should mention the removed_only comparison when it provides the evidence.
blocks.zh: - has_oclusion:只有当目标被前地场景几何学有意义地部分隐藏或参与非三角层的oclusion边界时才属实. 仅使用已删除的_仅作为主参考: 将目标 silhouette 和可见部分与在已删除的_仅中孤立的目标进行比较,它代表了没有场景占用器的同一目标. 如果某一部分在除去的_只可见,但消失或被切断,并精确地与前方场景几何经过其前方的地方,这就是隔离的有力证据. 必要时使用前/右/上视图作为目标完整结构的额外参考. 不要将图像框架裁剪,不完全删除的物体,自我隐蔽,阴影,或被完全可见的目标普通覆盖的背景归类为场景隐蔽. 理由必须确定前方占地者和它隐藏的目标部分,并应在提供证据时提及去除的_只比较。

blocks.en: - has_strong_perspective_depth: true when the scene has strong depth perspective around the target, such as large near-far scale variation, deep spatial placement, or substantial perspective deformation that makes insertion geometry harder. A normal perspective camera alone is not enough.
blocks.zh: - has_strong_perspective_深入:当场景在目标周围有强烈的深度视角时是真实的,如大型的近距离尺度变异,深空定位,或实质性的视角变形使得插入几何更难. 光是普通的镜头是不够的

blocks.en: - has_reflective_surface_interaction: this field is specifically about the inserted target changing the appearance of a pre-existing reflective or transmissive scene surface. Use Image 7 only to locate scene regions changed by inserting the target, then inspect the same coordinates in the original with and without images. Image 7 colors mean: blue = the scene became darker, red = the scene became brighter, green = the scene mainly changed color. The color itself does not determine the label.
blocks.zh: - 具有_ reflective_表面_interact:此字段具体指插入的目标改变先前存在的反射或传动场景表面的外观. 使用图像 7 只通过插入目标来定位更改的场景区域, 然后检查原始坐标中是否有图像。 图片7颜色表示:蓝色=场景变暗,红色=场景变亮,绿色=场景主要变色. 颜色本身并不决定标签。

blocks.en: Return true only when all of the following are satisfied: (1) the changed region is outside the inserted target; (2) the receiving scene surface is visibly identifiable as glossy, polished, metallic, glass, water, or another genuinely reflective/refractive material; (3) the aligned with/without comparison shows a clear target-caused change on that surface; (4) the change has reflection, specular-highlight, or refraction characteristics rather than ordinary diffuse illumination; and (5) the change is readily visible to a human at normal viewing scale. Examples that may qualify include the target or its color appearing in a glossy cabinet or polished floor, a target-caused specular highlight changing on metal or glass, or visible refraction through a transmissive scene surface.
blocks.zh: 只有当满足以下所有条件时,才能返回真实:(1) 改变的区域在插入的目标之外;(2) 接收场景表面可明显识别为光泽、抛光、金属、玻璃、水或其他真正反射/反射材料;(3) 与/不作比较,显示该表面有明显的目标导致的变化;(4) 变化具有反射、光谱高度或折射特性,而不是普通的散射;(5) 变化在正常视野范围内对人来说很容易看到。 可能符合条件的例子包括:目标或其颜色出现在光滑的柜子或抛光的地板上,目标导致的光谱亮度在金属或玻璃上变化,或通过传导场景表面可见折射.

blocks.en: Return false for ordinary diffuse brightening or darkening of walls, ceilings, fabric, matte wood, or other non-reflective surfaces; generic bounce light or color bleeding; illumination cast by an emissive target; target cast/contact shadows; ordinary light blocking; ambient occlusion; and any vague change for which the receiving surface cannot be confidently identified as reflective or transmissive. A recognizable mirror reflection belongs exclusively to has_mirror_reflection_interaction and must be false here.
blocks.zh: 对壁、天花板、布料、垫木或其他非反光表面进行普通散射亮度或变暗的光度、一般弹光或彩色出血、发射目标投射光度、目标投影/接触阴影、普通光阻、环境掩蔽、以及接收表面不能被确定为反射或传导的任何模糊变化。 一个可识别的镜像反射只属于 has_mirror_reflection_interactive, 并且必须在这里作假.

blocks.en: Material identity alone is not enough: the reflective/refractive content or highlight on that surface must visibly change between with and without. Conversely, a changed region alone is not enough: do not infer reflection merely from red, green, or blue pixels in Image 7. Image 7 is amplified and is never sufficient evidence by itself. When the material, cause, or human visibility is uncertain, return false.
blocks.zh: 仅凭物质特性是不够的:反射/反射内容或表面的突出点必须随与不发生明显变化。 反之,仅仅改变区域是不够的:不要仅仅从图像中的红色、绿色或蓝色像素推断反射 7个 图像7被放大,从来就不是充分的证据。 当材料,原因,或人类的能见度不确定时,返回虚假.

blocks.en: The reason must name the receiving scene surface and its visible reflective/transmissive material cue, identify the changed reflection/highlight/refraction, state whether Image 7 shows blue/red/green there, and confirm that the change remains readily visible in the original with/without images. For false, explicitly state which required condition is missing, such as no identifiable reflective receiver, only diffuse illumination, only shadow/light blocking, only a mirror reflection, or insufficient human-visible change.
blocks.zh: 原因必须指定接收场景表面及其可见的反射/传播材料提示,识别已改变的反射/亮度/折射,说明图像7是否显示蓝色/红色/绿色,并证实该变化在原图中与/无图像仍然很容易看到. 对于虚假的,明确要求条件的状态是缺失的,如没有可识别的反射接收器,只有散射,只有阴影/光阻,只有镜面反射,或者人视变化不足.

blocks.en: - has_mirror_reflection_interaction: true only when one of the following two evidence paths is satisfied:
blocks.zh: - has_mirror_reflection_interact:只有在满足以下两个证据路径之一时才为真 :

blocks.en: A. Scene-mirror change: a mirror or mirror-like scene surface contains recognizable reflected content that changes because of the target insertion. Compare the same mirror region at aligned coordinates in with and without. The reflected target, or another recognizable reflected scene object/structure whose mirror image is altered or occluded by the target, must appear, disappear, move, or visibly change between the two images. A mirror merely being present is false. An unchanged mirror image is false, even if it contains many recognizable scene objects.
blocks.zh: A类. 场景-镜像改变:镜像或镜像的场景表面包含可识别的反射内容,由于目标插入而改变. 在对齐的坐标上和不对齐的坐标上比较同一个镜面区域. 反射目标,或者另一个可识别的反射场景物体/结构,其镜像被目标改变或占据,必须在两个图像之间出现,消失,移动,或明显改变. 光有镜子是虚假的。 一个不变的镜像是虚假的,即使它包含许多可识别的场景对象.

blocks.en: B. Target-is-mirror: the inserted target itself is a mirror or contains a genuine mirror surface, and in with that target mirror visibly reflects recognizable objects or spatial structure from the surrounding environment. Use removed_only and the three views to confirm that the reflective surface belongs to the target, then identify the specific reflected environment content visible after insertion. This path does not require a with/without comparison inside the target region because the target mirror is absent in without.
blocks.zh: B. 目标 -- -- 模拟:插入的目标本身是一个镜子或包含一个真实的镜子表面,与目标镜子一起明显地反映周围环境中可辨认的物体或空间结构。 仅使用移除的_和三种视图确认反射面属于目标,然后识别插入后可见的特定反射环境内容. 这一路径不需要与目标区域内的/不作比较,因为目标镜不存在。

blocks.en: Mandatory decision procedure: first determine whether the candidate mirror belongs to the pre-existing scene or to the inserted target. For a pre-existing scene mirror, true requires a concrete aligned with/without change in its recognizable reflected content caused by the target. For a target mirror, true requires recognizable environment content inside the target mirror. Otherwise return false.
blocks.zh: 强制决定程序:首先确定候选镜是否属于原有场景或插入的目标. 对于先前存在的场景镜来说,真面目需要与目标造成的可识别的反射内容一致/不加改变的混凝土. 对于目标镜来说,真实性要求目标镜内部可识别的环境内容. 否则假归.

blocks.en: Do not use this field for ordinary glossy highlights, reflected color, illumination changes, vague silhouettes, blurry metallic reflections, dark screens, glass without recognizable reflected content, or changes outside the mirror region. Those may belong to has_reflective_surface_interaction but are not mirror interaction. The reason must name the mirror owner, the reflected object or structure, and either the exact with/without mirror-content change for path A or the recognizable environment content reflected by the target mirror for path B.
blocks.zh: 不要将这个字段用于普通的光泽亮度,反射的颜色,光线的变化,模糊的光线,模糊的金属反射,暗幕,没有可识别的反射内容的玻璃,或者镜面区域以外的变化. 这些可能属于“反射”-表面_交互,但不是镜像交互。 原因必须命名镜像所有者,被映射的对象或结构,以及路径 A 的精确/没有镜像内容变化,或者路径 B 的目标镜像所反映的可识别的环境内容.

blocks.en: - has_emissive_large_scale_lighting_change: true only when the target is self-emissive and its presence causes a visible large-scale illumination or color change in the surrounding environment. A glowing pixel or bright lamp surface without substantial environmental lighting change is false.
blocks.zh: - has_emissive_magroup_scale_lighting_change:只有目标自失能且其存在导致周围环境中可见的大规模照明或颜色变化时才为真. 发光像素或明亮的灯光表面没有重大的环境照明变化是虚假的.

blocks.en: Three-level integer fields (must be JSON integers 0, 1, or 2, not booleans):
blocks.zh: 三级整数字段( 必须是 JSON 整数 0, 1 或 2, 而不是布尔 ) :

blocks.en: - has_mechanical_interaction:
blocks.zh: - 有_机械_交互:

blocks.en: - 0 (none): no clearly visible support, contact, suspension, attachment, or other meaningful force relation with scene geometry can be identified.
blocks.zh: - 0(无):无法识别与场景几何相关的明显可见的支持,接触,悬浮,附着或其他有意义的力关系.

blocks.en: - 1 (simple): ordinary static support and gravity balance through one simple support arrangement, such as an object resting on a table, shelf, floor, or a single regular base. A target simply mounted on or placed against a wall also counts as simple when no explicit load-bearing suspension mechanism or positional constraint is visible; an object that could plausibly occupy an arbitrary wall position must not be promoted to level 2 merely because it is described as hanging. Several feet touching the same flat floor still normally count as simple unless they create a genuinely nontrivial balance.
blocks.zh: - 1(简单):普通静态支持和重力平衡,通过一个简单的支持安排,例如一个物体在桌子,架子,地板上休息,或者一个单一的固定基座. 仅仅挂在墙上或放在墙上的目标,在没有明显的负载悬浮机制或位置约束的情况下,也算作简单;一个可以合理占据任意墙位的物体,不能仅仅因为被描述为悬挂而晋升到二级。 接触同一平地的几英尺通常仍算得简单,除非它们能形成真正的非三角平衡。

blocks.en: - 2 (complex): nontrivial force balance involving multiple independent support/contact points or constraints from different directions, tension, clamping, leaning with multiple force-bearing contacts, or another mechanically coupled arrangement whose stability depends on more than ordinary single-surface support. A hanging or suspended target qualifies as level 2 only when the images show an explicit suspension dependency and load path, such as a visible hook, rope, cable, chain, bracket, slot, ceiling attachment, or multiple suspension points that constrain and support the target. Do not infer complex suspension from semantic identity or wall placement alone.
blocks.zh: - 2(复杂):非三角力平衡,涉及来自不同方向的多个独立支持/接触点或制约、紧张、夹住、倾斜多种强力接触,或另一种机械偶联安排,其稳定性取决于超出普通单表面支持。 悬挂或悬浮目标只有在图像显示明显的悬浮依赖和负载路径,如可见的钩子,绳索,电缆,链条,括号,插槽,天花板附件,或限制和支持目标的多个悬浮点时,才符合第二级条件. 不得从语义特征或墙壁放置中推断复杂的悬浮。

blocks.en: Mere proximity without visible force-bearing contact is 0. Assign level 2 only from visible mechanical evidence, not from an assumption about how the object is normally installed. State the visible support/contact points, suspension mechanism, and force relation in the reason.
blocks.zh: 没有可见力接触的近距离为0. 只从可见的机械证据来指定第二级,而不是从对物体通常如何安装的假设来指定. 说明可见的支持/接触点、暂停机制以及武力关系。

blocks.en: - has_complex_lighting_shadows:
blocks.zh: - 有_复杂_亮_阴影:

blocks.en: - 0 (none): no clearly identifiable target-related shadow is visible; extremely weak generic ambient occlusion that cannot be confidently attributed to the target also counts as 0.
blocks.zh: - 0(无):没有明显可识别的目标相关阴影可见;无法自信地归属于目标的极弱的通用环境隔离也算为0.

blocks.en: - 1 (simple): exactly one dominant target-related contact/cast shadow direction or one coherent shadow lobe is visible under otherwise simple lighting. A soft shadow still counts, but level 1 is allowed only after checking all sides of the target and finding no second independently directed target shadow.
blocks.zh: - 1(简单):在原本简单的照明下,完全可见一个与目标相关的主要接触/广播阴影方向或一个连贯的阴影叶。 柔软的阴影仍然算数,但1级只有在检查目标方方面面,发现没有第二位独立定向的目标阴影后才允许.

blocks.en: - 2 (complex): assign level 2 whenever two or more distinct target-related cast-shadow lobes or projections are visible in different directions, on opposite sides of the target, or on different receiving surfaces. This is direct evidence of multiple or spatially varied light contributions. The shadows may be soft, faint, partially overlapping, or unequal in strength; they do not need to be crisp, high-contrast, intricate, or produced by obvious visible lamps. Also use level 2 for split illumination across the target, multiple light directions, overlapping shadows, strongly spatially varying light, or intricate/high-contrast shadow patterns.
blocks.zh: - 2(复杂):当两个或两个以上不同的目标相关铸影叶或预测在不同方向、目标对面或不同接收面可见时,指定二级。 这是多种或空间差异的光作用的直接证据。 阴影可能是软的,微弱的,部分重叠的,或者强度不平等的;它们不需要脆脆的,高的,复杂的,或者由明显的可见灯光产生. 也使用二级来进行横跨目标的分光,多光方向,重叠的阴影,强烈的空间差异的光,或复杂/高孔的阴影模式.

blocks.en: Mandatory shadow inspection procedure:
blocks.zh: 强制性影子检查程序:

blocks.en: 1. Locate the complete target using with and removed_only, then inspect the floor/support and the full perimeter on its left, right, front, and back image sides rather than stopping at the strongest shadow.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 定位仅使用和删除的完整目标,然后检查其左、右、前、后图像侧的地板/支持和整个周边,而不是最强的阴影。

blocks.en: 2. Compare the same coordinates in with and without. A dark or shaded lobe that appears with the target and disappears or weakens without it is target-related evidence. Use Image 7 to locate subtle non-target changes, then verify them in with/without.
blocks.zh: 2. 国家 将同一坐标与无坐标进行比较。 与目标一起出现并消失或削弱的暗色或遮蔽叶片是目标相关证据. 使用图像 7 来定位微妙的非目标更改, 然后用/ 不使用这些更改来验证 。

blocks.en: 3. Inspect shadows cast by nearby scene objects as supporting evidence for the scene light directions. If those shadows reveal illumination from multiple directions, actively search for the corresponding weaker target projections; scene-object shadows are clues, but level 2 still requires visible target-related shadow or split-light evidence.
blocks.zh: 3个 附近场景物体所投下的检查阴影,作为场景灯光方向的支持证据. 如果这些阴影从多个方向显示出照明,则积极搜索相应的较弱的目标预测;场景-对象阴影是线索,但第2级仍然需要与目标相关的明显阴影或分光证据.

blocks.en: 4. If two target shadows extend to the left and right, or otherwise diverge in direction, classify level 2 even when one is much softer or less visible than the other. A common level-2 case is one strong lobe on one side plus one broad faint lobe on the opposite side. Do not merge them into one soft shadow and do not reject the weaker lobe merely because its boundary is diffuse.
blocks.zh: 4个 如果两个目标阴影延伸至左右,或者在方向上有所区别,即使一个比另一个要柔软或不太明显,也要将第二级分类. 常见的2级病例是一侧的强叶加上另一侧的宽弱叶. 不要把它们合并成一个柔软的阴影,不要仅仅因为弱叶的边界分散而拒绝它。

blocks.en: 5. Distinguish ambient occlusion from a weak cast shadow spatially. Ambient occlusion is restricted to a narrow contact rim or crevice that tightly hugs the target base with no directional outward extent. A dark region that spreads outward from the silhouette over the receiving surface, has a displaced or directional lobe shape, or occupies a broader area than the immediate contact rim is a shadow projection, even if it is faint and soft.
blocks.zh: 5.五. 在空间空间上将环境隔离与弱影区分开来。 环境隔离被限制在狭长的接触圈或裂缝上,紧紧地拥抱目标基地,没有方向外径. 黑暗区域从光圈向外扩散到接收的表面,具有偏移或方向叶形,或占据比直接接触线圈更宽的区域是阴影投影,即使它微弱柔软.

blocks.en: 6. Use scene lighting evidence as a tie-breaker. When nearby objects show shadows or highlights consistent with two light directions, and the target has one strong lobe plus a weaker outward-spreading lobe in the corresponding second direction, count both target lobes and assign level 2. Do not call the weaker lobe ambient occlusion unless it is strictly confined to the narrow target-contact boundary.
blocks.zh: 6个 使用场景照明证据作为打结机. 当附近的物体显示与两个光线方向一致的阴影或亮度,而目标有一个坚固的叶片加上相应的第二个方向的较弱的向外扩张的叶片时,计算两个目标叶片并分配级别. 2. 国家 不要称弱叶环境闭塞,除非它严格限于狭小的目标接触边界.

blocks.en: Calibration example: a round chair on a rug with a visible projection to its right and a weaker but spatially extended projection to its left is level 2, not level 1. Softness and unequal intensity do not reduce the number of shadow directions.
blocks.zh: 校准实例:地毯上的圆椅,右侧有可见投影,左侧有较弱但空间延伸的投影是第二级,而非第二级 1. 软度和不平等强度不会减少阴影方向的数量。

blocks.en: Do not count truly generic ambient occlusion or texture darkening as an additional cast shadow. The reason must enumerate every detected target shadow by image-relative direction and receiving surface. A level-1 reason must explicitly state that every other dark region is confined to a narrow contact rim with no outward directional extent; saying only that it is faint or soft is not sufficient to reject it.
blocks.zh: 不要把真正通用的环境遮蔽或纹理变暗算作额外的阴影。 理由必须按图像相对方向和接收表面列出每个被探测到的目标阴影。 一级理由必须明确指出,所有其他黑暗区域都局限于一个狭窄的接触圈,没有外向方向;只说它微弱或柔软不足以拒绝它。

blocks.zh: [产出要求]

blocks.en: Appendix K User Study Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录 K 用户研究协议

blocks.en: We collect complete responses from 27 distinct participants on 25 in-the-wild insertion cases, comparing PhysInsert, Insert-Anything, DIRECT, and Nano Banana Pro. Method identities are hidden, and case and method orders are randomized. These cases form a separate user-study set constructed by combining scenes from RealBokeh with foreground objects from Distinctions-646. With the background and object reference visible, participants rate side-by-side results from 1 to 5 (higher is better) on lighting integration (including object illumination and cast shadows), perspective, pose, identity preservation, and background preservation. We average over cases within each participant, then across participants; the overall score equally weights the five criteria.
blocks.zh: 我们收集了27个不同参与者对25个 " 零散 " 插入案例的完整答复,比较了 " 物理Insert " 、 " 插入-任何东西 " 、 " DIRECT " 和 " Nano Banana Pro " 。 方法身份是隐藏的,大小写和方法命令是随机的. 这些案例通过结合RealBokeh的场景和区分-646的前缘物体而形成单独的用户-研究集. 随着背景和对象参考的可见,参与者在照明融合(包括物体照明和投影),视角,姿势,身份保存,背景保存等方面对1至5的并排结果进行评分(较高更佳). 我们平均衡量每个参与者的情况,然后衡量参与者的情况;总得分对五个标准都具有同等的权重。
